title: Legislators
description: Legislators determine, formulate, and direct policies of national, state, regional or local governments and international governmental agencies. They make, ratify, amend or repeal laws, public rules and regulations. They include elected and non- elected members of parliament, councils and governments.
pay_rationale: Elected officials and top government policymakers typically command significantly higher compensation and allowances than the average salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: The number of legislative seats is fixed by law, leading to very stable employment numbers with negligible structural growth outside of newly formed local bodies.
exposure_rationale: Legislators rely primarily on human political representation, negotiation, decision-making, and public interaction, which cannot be automated by AI.

title: Senior Government Officials
description: Senior government officials advise governments on policy matters, oversee the interpretation and implementation of government policies and legislation by government departments and agencies, represent their country abroad and act on its behalf, or carry out similar tasks in intergovernmental organizations. They plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the overall activities of municipal or local, regional and national government departments, boards, agencies or commissions in accordance with legislation and policies established by government and legislative bodies.
pay_rationale: Senior government officials command significantly higher compensation and benefits compared to the average regular wage worker in India.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth driven by expanding administrative needs and governance structures at various levels, though constrained by government recruitment policies.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with policy analysis, drafting documents, and summarizing information, but decision-making, stakeholder negotiation, and political oversight remain deeply human functions.

title: Senior Officials of Special-interest Organizations
description: Senior Officials of Special-interest Organizations determine, formulate and direct the implementation of policies of special-interest organizations, such as political-party organizations, trade unions, employers' organizations, trade and industry associations, humanitarian or charity organizations, or sports associations, and represent their organizations and act on their behalf.
pay_rationale: Senior leadership roles in recognized special-interest organizations command significantly higher remuneration than the average salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of civil society, industry bodies, trade associations, and non-profits in India drives moderate job growth.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with policy drafting, member communications, and data analysis, but leadership, advocacy, and interpersonal negotiation require human presence.

title: Managing Directors and Chief Executives
description: Managing Directors and Chief Executives formulate and review the policies and plan, direct co-ordinate and evaluate the overall activities of enterprises or organizations (except special interest organizations and government departments). They work with the support of other managers, usually within guidelines established by a Board of Directors or a governing body to whom they are answerable for the operations undertaken and their result.
pay_rationale: Top corporate executives command compensation packages far exceeding the general average for regular salaried workers due to the high strategic value of their roles.
outlook_rationale: Strong corporate and economic growth in India, coupled with expanding startup and private sector ecosystems, drives robust demand for top-tier executive leadership.
exposure_rationale: AI will significantly assist with data analysis, strategic planning, and report generation, but core responsibilities involving high-stakes decision-making, stakeholder negotiation, and organizational leadership remain inherently human.

title: Finance Managers
description: Finance Managers plan, direct and co- ordinate the financial operations of an enterprise or organization, in consultation with Senior Managers and with Managers of other departments or sections.
pay_rationale: Finance managers command salaries significantly above the average for regular wage-salaried employees due to their specialized expertise and high corporate responsibility.
outlook_rationale: Strong economic growth and expansion of corporate enterprises in India continue to drive high demand for skilled financial leadership and management.
exposure_rationale: AI tools will increasingly automate financial analysis, forecasting, and reporting, shifting the role more toward strategic decision-making and human oversight.

title: Human Resource Managers
description: Human Resource Managers, plan, direct and co-ordinate policies concerning the personnel, industrial relations and occupational health and safety activities of an enterprise or organization, or of enterprises that provide human resource services to other enterprises and organizations.
pay_rationale: HR managers earn significantly above the average for regular wage/salaried employees due to their specialized administrative and managerial skills.
outlook_rationale: Strong corporate sector growth and expansion of startups and multinational enterprises in India continue to drive the demand for structured human resource management.
exposure_rationale: AI tools significantly assist with resume screening, talent acquisition, and HR analytics, but the core functions of employee relations, negotiation, and strategic management require human intelligence.

title: Policy and Planning Managers
description: Policy and Planning Managers plan, organize, direct and co-ordinate policy advice and strategic planning activities within government or for non- government organizations and private sector agencies, or manage the activities of enterprises that provide policy and strategic planning services.
pay_rationale: As senior managerial roles requiring high-level expertise, compensation is well above the average for regular wage and salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Demand for strategic planning and policy management is growing as both government and private sectors navigate complex economic reforms, digital transformation, and regulatory changes in India.
exposure_rationale: Policy and strategic planning heavily involve digital data analysis, report generation, and document drafting, which are areas seeing rapid automation and augmentation by advanced language and analytics models.

title: Business Services and Administration Managers Not Elsewhere Classified This unit group
description: covers Business Services and Administration Managers not classified elsewhere in group 121, Business services and Administration Managers. For instance, the group includes occupations such as Facilities Manager, Cleaning Services Manager, Administrative Services Manager.
pay_rationale: These management roles command solid mid-to-senior level salaries above the average for regular wage workers due to the organizational responsibility involved.
outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization, commercial real estate expansion, and the growth of corporate offices in India drive strong demand for professional administrative and facilities management.
exposure_rationale: Administrative and facilities management involves a mix of physical oversight, vendor coordination, and digital data processing, meaning AI will assist with scheduling and paperwork without replacing the physical management aspects.

title: Sales and Marketing Managers
description: Sales and Marketing Managers plan, direct and co-ordinate the sales and marketing activities of an enterprise or organization, or of enterprises that provide sales and marketing services to other enterprises and organizations.
pay_rationale: Managers in sales and marketing earn significantly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to their direct impact on business revenues.
outlook_rationale: Expanding domestic consumer markets, retail growth, and digital transformation across Indian businesses continue to drive strong demand for commercial and marketing leadership.
exposure_rationale: AI tools significantly assist with market research, campaign planning, and customer analytics, but strategy, client relationship management, and team leadership require human presence.

title: Advertising and Public Relation Managers
description: Advertising and Public Relation Managers plan, direct and co-ordinate the advertising, public relations and public information activities of enterprises and organizations or of enterprises that provide related services to other enterprises and organizations.
pay_rationale: Advertising and PR managers typically command significantly higher compensation than the average regular wage worker due to the strategic nature of their roles.
outlook_rationale: Strong growth in India's digital economy, media consumption, and corporate competitiveness continues to drive demand for advertising and public relations professionals.
exposure_rationale: Much of the work involves strategy, content planning, and communication that can be heavily augmented or automated by generative AI tools, though human leadership and relationship management remain essential.

title: Agricultural and Forestry Production Managers
description: Agricultural and Forestry Production Managers plan, direct, and co-ordinate production in large scale agricultural, horticultural and forestry operations such as plantations, large ranches, collective farms and agricultural co-operatives to grow and harvest crops, and breed and raise livestock.
pay_rationale: Earns modestly above the general regular wage/salaried average due to supervisory responsibilities in commercial agricultural enterprises.
outlook_rationale: Commercial and contract farming, along with modernized plantation management, are driving modest growth in organized agricultural production leadership.
exposure_rationale: While agricultural management is adopting precision farming technologies and data-driven analytics, the role requires continuous physical presence, local operational judgment, and hands-on oversight.

title: Manufacturing Managers
description: Manufacturing Managers plan, direct, and co-ordinate manufacturing production activities of large enterprises or as the manager of a small manufacturing company.
pay_rationale: Manufacturing managers command significantly higher earnings than the average salaried worker due to their strategic responsibilities and specialized expertise.
outlook_rationale: Driven by government initiatives like 'Make in India' and the expansion of the manufacturing sector, demand for skilled manufacturing managers is expected to grow steadily.
exposure_rationale: AI will increasingly assist with predictive maintenance, supply chain optimization, and production scheduling, but the core leadership, coordination, and plant oversight require human presence and decision-making.

title: Mining Managers
description: Mining Managers plan, direct, and co- ordinate the production activities of mining, quarrying and oil and gas extraction operations.
pay_rationale: Mining managers require specialised engineering expertise and hold high-responsibility leadership roles, commanding significantly higher earnings than the average regular wage worker.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth driven by ongoing infrastructure development, mineral extraction demands, and energy needs in India, tempered by technological efficiency gains.
exposure_rationale: AI and automation are increasingly used in predictive maintenance, resource estimation, and operational monitoring in mining, but core managerial, planning, and safety-critical decisions still require human presence and judgment.

title: Construction Managers
description: Construction Managers plan, direct and co-ordinate the construction of civil engineering projects, buildings and dwellings.
pay_rationale: Construction managers require specialized technical and administrative skills, commanding wages significantly above the average regular salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization, infrastructure development, and real estate expansion in India drive strong demand for construction management professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI will assist with project management, scheduling, and cost estimation software, but the core work of physical site coordination, team management, and stakeholder negotiation remains heavily human-centric.

title: Supply, Distribution and Related Managers
description: Supply, Distribution and Related Managers plan, direct and co-ordinate the supply, transportation, storage and distribution of goods.
pay_rationale: These management positions typically command significantly higher salaries than the average regular wage worker in India due to required expertise and responsibility.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of e-commerce, retail, and manufacturing supply chains in India is driving strong demand for logistics and distribution managers.
exposure_rationale: AI and predictive analytics are increasingly used for inventory management, route optimization, and demand forecasting, but the core management, vendor negotiation, and operational oversight remain distinctly human.

title: Information and Communication Technology Services
description: Managers Information and Communications Technology Service Managers plan, direct, and co-ordinate the acquisition, development, maintenance and use of computer and telecommunication systems.
pay_rationale: As senior professionals managing critical organizational technology infrastructure and teams, their compensation significantly exceeds the average for regular wage and salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Strong digital transformation initiatives across Indian industries and the continuous expansion of the IT/ITeS sector drive robust demand for skilled ICT leadership.
exposure_rationale: While ICT service managers oversee digital systems and workflows that can be optimized by AI, their core responsibilities of leadership, strategic planning, and stakeholder management require strong human presence and judgment.

title: Education Managers
description: Education Managers plan, direct, co- ordinate and evaluate the educational and administrative aspects of education services, primary and secondary schools, colleges and faculties and departments in universities and other educational institutions.
pay_rationale: Education managers typically earn above the average for regular wage/salaried workers due to the leadership responsibilities and qualifications required.
outlook_rationale: Driven by the expansion of private and public educational institutions across India and increasing focus on institutional quality and administration.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with administrative tasks, scheduling, and data analysis, but education management relies heavily on human leadership, interpersonal communication, and institutional decision-making.

title: Financial and Insurance Service Branch Managers
description: Financial and Insurance Service Branch Managers plan, direct, and co-ordinate the branches of institutions that provide financial and insurance services, such as banks, building societies, credit unions and insurance companies. They provide advice and assistance to clients on financial and insurance matters.
pay_rationale: As managerial professionals in the financial sector, their earnings are significantly higher than the average regular wage worker in India.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of formal banking, financial inclusion initiatives, and insurance penetration in India will drive steady demand for branch managers.
exposure_rationale: Branch managers rely heavily on human leadership, relationship management, and complex decision-making, though routine reporting and data analysis tasks will be partially automated by AI.

title: Hotel Managers
description: Hotel Managers plan, organize and direct the operations of hotels, motels and similar establishments to provide guest accommodation and other services.
pay_rationale: Hotel managers earn significantly above the average regular salaried worker due to the strategic responsibilities and specialized skills required.
outlook_rationale: Expanding tourism, hospitality sectors, and rising middle-class disposable incomes in India will drive steady job growth for hotel managers.
exposure_rationale: AI will automate routine administrative tasks, scheduling, and booking management, but core management requires human leadership, guest relations, and crisis handling.

title: Restaurant Managers
description: Restaurant Managers plan, organize and direct the operations of cafes, restaurants and related establishments to provide dining and catering services.
pay_rationale: Restaurant managers earn moderately above the average for regular wage/salaried employees due to supervisory responsibilities and the specialized skills required in hospitality.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of the organized dining, hospitality, and food-service sectors in urban India drives strong demand for professional restaurant managers.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with administrative tasks, inventory management, and scheduling, but the core of the role relies on human supervision, customer service, and real-time establishment operations.

title: Retail and Wholesale Trade Managers
description: Retail and Wholesale Trade Managers, plan, organize, co-ordinate and control the operations of establishments that sell goods on a retail or wholesale basis. They are responsible for the budgets, staffing and strategic and operational direction of shops, or of organizational units within shops that sell particular types of products.
pay_rationale: Retail and wholesale managers typically earn moderately above the average regular salaried worker due to supervisory responsibilities and business oversight.
outlook_rationale: Strong growth is expected driven by the rapid expansion of organized retail, e-commerce, and modern wholesale networks across urban and semi-urban India.
exposure_rationale: AI will increasingly assist with inventory management, sales forecasting, and customer analytics, but core managerial tasks like staff coordination and operational oversight require on-site human presence.

title: Sports, Recreation and Cultural Centre Managers
description: Sports, Recreation and Cultural Centre Managers plan, organize, and control the operations of establishments that provide sporting, artistic, theatrical and other recreational and amenity services.
pay_rationale: Facility managers typically earn moderately above the average for regular wage or salaried workers due to the leadership and organizational responsibilities required.
outlook_rationale: Rising disposable incomes, urbanization, and a growing emphasis on health, fitness, and entertainment in India are driving rapid expansion in sports and cultural facilities.
exposure_rationale: The role relies heavily on human-centric management, interpersonal communication, physical facility oversight, and event coordination, which have very low risk of direct automation by AI.

title: Physicists and Astronomers
description: Physicists and Astronomers conduct research and improve or develop concepts, theories and operational methods concerning matter, space, time, energy, forces and fields and the interrelationship between these physical phenomena. They apply scientific knowledge relating to physics and astronomy in industrial, medical, military or other fields.
pay_rationale: Highly specialized scientific professionals command salaries well above the average for regular wage/salaried employees in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth will be driven by increased public and private investments in research, space exploration, and advanced technology sectors in India.
exposure_rationale: AI will significantly assist physicists and astronomers in data analysis, simulations, and pattern recognition, but the core work of theoretical formulation and experimental design still requires deep human judgment.

title: Meteorologists
description: Meteorologists prepare short-term or long-term weather forecasts used in aviation, shipping, agriculture and other areas and for the information of general public. They conduct research related to the composition, structure and dynamics of the atmosphere.
pay_rationale: As specialized scientific professionals, meteorologists typically earn above the average for regular wage-salaried employees in India.
outlook_rationale: Growing demand for accurate weather forecasting driven by climate change concerns, agricultural needs, and disaster management is expected to drive steady employment growth.
exposure_rationale: AI and machine learning are increasingly used for numerical weather prediction and data analysis, but meteorologists are still required to interpret complex models, conduct atmospheric research, and communicate forecasts.

title: Chemists
description: Chemists conduct research, improve or develop concepts, theories and operational methods, or apply scientific knowledge relating to chemistry, to develop new knowledge or products and for quality and process control.
pay_rationale: As professional scientific workers, qualified chemists earn above the average for regular wage-salaried employees in India.
outlook_rationale: Demand for chemists is driven by the expansion of India's pharmaceutical, chemical manufacturing, and quality assurance sectors.
exposure_rationale: AI and machine learning significantly accelerate chemical formulation, data analysis, and literature reviews, but physical laboratory experimentation, synthesis, and quality control still require human presence.

title: Geologists and Geophysicists
description: Geologists and Geophysicists conduct research; improve or develop concepts, theories and operational methods, or apply scientific knowledge relating to geology and geophysics in such fields as oil, gas and mineral exploration and extraction, water conservation, civil engineering, telecommunications and navigation, and assessment and mitigation of the effects of development and waste disposal projects on the environment.
pay_rationale: Specialized scientific professionals in exploration and civil engineering typically earn well above the average for regular wage-salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth is expected driven by infrastructure development, mining exploration, and environmental assessment projects across India.
exposure_rationale: AI and machine learning are increasingly used to process geological data, seismic surveys, and remote sensing imagery, but fieldwork, physical sampling, and expert interpretation still require significant human presence and judgment.

title: Mathematicians, Actuaries and Statisticians
description: Mathematicians, Actuaries and Statisticians conduct research and improve or develop mathematical, actuarial and statistical concepts, theories and operational methods and techniques and advise on or engage in their practical application in such fields as engineering, business and social and other sciences.
pay_rationale: Highly specialized quantitative skills command a substantial premium well above the average regular salaried wage in India.
outlook_rationale: Strong and accelerating demand for data science, analytics, and risk assessment across India's growing IT, financial, and e-commerce sectors will drive robust employment growth.
exposure_rationale: While statistical and mathematical modeling involves deep human judgment and domain expertise, a significant portion of data processing, coding, and routine analysis can be automated or heavily augmented by advanced AI systems.

title: Biologists, Botanists, Zoologists and Related Professionals
description: Biologists, Botanists, Zoologists and related professionals study living organisms and their interactions with each other and with the environment, and apply this knowledge to solve human health and environmental problems. They work in diverse fields such as botany, zoology, ecology, marine biology, genetics, immunology, pharmacology, toxicology, physiology, bacteriology and virology.
pay_rationale: Specialized scientific professionals earn significantly above the average for regular wage and salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Growing demand for environmental conservation, biotechnology, and agricultural research in India supports steady employment growth.
exposure_rationale: AI is increasingly used for genetic sequencing, data analysis, and ecological modeling, but field research, laboratory experiments, and physical sample collection remain hands-on.

title: Farming, Forestry and Fisheries Advisors
description: Farming, Forestry and Fisheries Advisers study and provide assistance and advice on farm, forestry and fisheries management, including cultivation, fertilization, harvesting, soil erosion and composition, disease prevention, nutrition, crop rotation and marketing. They develop techniques for increasing productivity, and study and develop plans and policies for land and fisheries management.
pay_rationale: Advisors with specialized professional knowledge typically earn slightly above the average for regular wage or salaried professionals in the agricultural sector.
outlook_rationale: Demand for sustainable agriculture, improved productivity, and scientific farming methods will drive moderate growth in advisory roles.
exposure_rationale: AI and data-driven tools significantly enhance research, yield prediction, and resource planning, but fieldwork, advisory interactions, and localized assessment require human judgment.

title: Environmental Protection Professionals
description: Environmental Protection Professionals study and assess the effects of human activity on environment such as air, water and noise pollution, soil contamination, climate change, toxic waste and depletion and degradation of natural resources. They develop plans and solutions to protect, conserve, restore, minimize and prevent further damage to the environment.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical knowledge places these professionals above average earners in the regular salaried category.
outlook_rationale: Growing regulatory scrutiny, climate change initiatives, and urban sustainability projects in India will increase demand for environmental professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI will significantly assist in environmental data analysis, modeling, and report generation, but field assessments, policy implementation, and stakeholder engagement require human presence.

title: Industrial and Production Engineers
description: Industrial and Production Engineers conduct research and design, organize and oversee the construction, operation and maintenance of process plants and installations. They establish programmes for the co-ordination of manufacturing activities; and assess cost effectiveness and safety.
pay_rationale: As qualified engineering professionals, they earn significantly above the average for regular wage/salaried employees in India.
outlook_rationale: Strong government push for manufacturing growth (e.g., Make in India, PLI schemes) drives demand for industrial and production engineers in factories and process plants.
exposure_rationale: AI and simulation tools assist with process optimization, supply chain forecasting, and plant design, but physical implementation, safety oversight, and shop-floor management require human presence.

title: Civil Engineers
description: Civil Engineers conduct research, advice on design, and direct construction; manage the operation and maintenance of civil engineering structures; or study and advise on technological aspects of particular materials.
pay_rationale: Engineers command higher salaries than the average regular wage worker due to specialized technical training and professional qualification.
outlook_rationale: Strong infrastructure development, urban expansion, and government spending on transportation and real estate in India drive high demand for civil engineers.
exposure_rationale: AI assists with computer-aided design (CAD), structural simulation, and project planning, but the physical nature of on-site construction management and safety oversight limits direct automation.

title: Environmental Engineers
description: Environmental Engineers conduct research, advise on design and direct implementation of solutions to prevent, control or remedy of negative impacts of human activity on the environment utilizing a variety of engineering disciplines. They conduct environmental assessments of construction and civil engineering projects and apply engineering principles for pollution control, recycling and waste disposal.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals in a growing technical field, environmental engineers earn considerably higher than the average regular wage worker.
outlook_rationale: Increasing industrialization, stricter environmental regulations, and a growing focus on sustainability and pollution control in India are driving demand for environmental engineers.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can assist with environmental modeling, data analysis, and report generation, but fieldwork, site assessments, and complex engineering design require human judgment and physical presence.

title: Mechanical Engineers
description: Mechanical Engineers conduct research; advise on design, and direct production of machines, aircraft, ships, machinery and industrial plant equipment and systems; advise on and direct their functioning, maintenance and repair; or study and advise on mechanical aspects of particular materials, products or processes.
pay_rationale: As professional degree holders in regular wage/salaried employment, mechanical engineers earn significantly above the category average.
outlook_rationale: Growth will be driven by India's expanding manufacturing sector, infrastructure projects, and 'Make in India' initiatives.
exposure_rationale: AI tools will assist mechanical engineers with computer-aided design, simulation, and optimization, but physical prototyping and hands-on testing require human presence.

title: Chemical Engineers
description: Chemical Engineers conduct research and develop advice and direct commercial- scale chemical processes and production of various substances and items, such as crude oil, petroleum derivatives, food and drinks, medicines, or synthetic materials. They direct maintenance and repair of chemical plants and equipment and study and advise on chemical aspects of particular materials, products or processes.
pay_rationale: As specialized technical professionals, chemical engineers earn significantly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by expanding chemical, pharmaceutical, and energy sectors in India, alongside increasing demand for sustainable and green manufacturing processes.
exposure_rationale: Chemical engineering involves complex physical plant design, on-site operations, and physical safety management where AI assists in process simulation and optimization rather than replacing the engineering role entirely.

title: Mining Engineers, Metallurgists and Related Professionals
description: Mining Engineers, metallurgists and related professionals conduct research on and, design, develop and maintain commercial-scale methods of extracting metals from their ores, or minerals, water, oil or gas from the earth and of developing new alloys, ceramic and other materials, or study and advise on mining or metallurgical aspects of particular materials, products or processes.
pay_rationale: As specialized technical professionals requiring rigorous university education, their earnings are significantly higher than the average regular wage worker.
outlook_rationale: Growth is tied to the expansion of the manufacturing, infrastructure, and mining sectors under government initiatives, though automation will moderate net hiring needs.
exposure_rationale: Mining and metallurgical engineering involve substantial physical and on-site operational knowledge, though AI and simulation software are increasingly used for design, geological modeling, and process optimization.

title: Engineering Professionals, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This unit group covers Engineering Professionals not classified elsewhere in minor group 214, Engineering professionals (excluding electro- technology) or in minor group 215, Electro-technology Engineers. For instance, the group includes those who conduct research, advise on or develop engineering procedures and solutions concerning workplace safety, biomedical engineering, optics, materials, nuclear power generation and explosives.
pay_rationale: Specialized advanced engineering skills command a solid premium above the general average for regular wage-salaried professionals.
outlook_rationale: Expanding industrialization, nuclear energy initiatives, and a growing focus on workplace safety and biomedical applications in India drive steady demand for specialized engineers.
exposure_rationale: Specialized engineering professionals use computational modeling and simulation tools enhanced by AI, but physical research, material testing, and applied safety protocols require continuous human oversight.

title: Electrical Engineers
description: Electrical Engineers conduct research and advice on, design, and direct the construction and operation of electrical systems, components, motors and equipment, and advise on and direct their functioning, maintenance and repair, or study and advise on technological aspects of electrical engineering materials, products and processes.
pay_rationale: Professional engineering roles command salaries significantly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by infrastructure development, power sector modernization, and the transition toward renewable energy and electric vehicles in India.
exposure_rationale: AI tools assist with circuit design, simulation, and diagnostic data analysis, but physical prototyping, testing, and site supervision still require human engineering presence.

title: Electronics Engineers
description: Electronics Engineers conduct research on, design, and direct the construction functioning, maintenance and repair of electronic systems and study and advise on technological aspects of electronic engineering materials, products or processes.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals in high demand, electronics engineers earn significantly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Strong growth driven by government initiatives in semiconductor manufacturing, electronics hardware production (Make in India), and IoT deployment.
exposure_rationale: AI will assist with electronic circuit design, simulation, and debugging, but physical prototyping, hardware testing, and manufacturing oversight still require substantial human engineering presence.

title: Telecommunication Engineers
description: Telecommunications Engineers conduct research and advise on, design, and direct the construction functioning, maintenance and repair of telecommunication systems and equipment. They study and advise on technological aspects of telecommunication engineering materials, products or processes.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals in a growing tech sector, they earn significantly above the average regular salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of 5G rollouts, fiber-optic networks, and digital infrastructure across India drives steady demand for telecom professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can assist in network design, optimization, and predictive maintenance, but the core engineering judgment and physical deployment oversight require human expertise.

title: Building Architects
description: Building architects design commercial, industrial, institutional, residential and recreational buildings and plan and monitor their construction, maintenance and rehabilitation.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals requiring advanced training, architects earn significantly above the average for regular wage or salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization, infrastructure development, and a booming real estate sector in India drive strong demand for architectural services.
exposure_rationale: AI tools significantly assist in drafting, design optimization, and spatial planning, transforming routine architectural tasks while retaining the need for human creativity and regulatory approval.

title: Product and Garment Designers
description: Product and Garment Designers design and develop products for manufacture and prepare designs and Specifications of products for mass, batch and one-off production.
pay_rationale: Skilled professionals in urban design studios and export houses command earnings moderately higher than the average for regular wage or salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Expanding domestic consumption, organized retail, and the growing apparel and manufacturing sectors in India drive steady demand for product and garment designers.
exposure_rationale: AI tools significantly assist in generating design concepts, pattern making, and 3D rendering, but final aesthetic judgment and client interaction still require human expertise.

title: Town and Traffic Planners
description: Town and Traffic Planners develop and implement plans and policies for the controlled use of urban and rural land and for traffic systems. They conduct research and provide advice on economic, environmental and social factors affecting land use and traffic flows.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals working on government or corporate infrastructure projects, town planners earn comfortably above the average for regular wage and salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization, smart city initiatives, and infrastructure development across India are driving strong demand for urban planning professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI tools significantly assist with traffic simulation, geographic information systems (GIS), and spatial data analysis, but human judgment is required for policy formulation and stakeholder engagement.

title: Cartographers and Surveyors
description: Cartographers and Surveyors determine the exact position of, or prepare and revise digital, graphic and pictorial maps, charts or other visual representations of, natural and constructed features and boundaries of land, seas, underground areas and celestial bodies, applying scientific and mathematical principles.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills in geospatial technology and land surveying command wages above the general average for salaried professionals.
outlook_rationale: Increased infrastructure development, urban planning, and real estate projects across India are driving strong demand for modern geospatial and surveying professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI and advanced GIS automation streamline digital mapping and spatial data analysis, but physical surveying and on-site measurements still require human presence.

title: Graphic and Multimedia Designers
description: Graphic and Multimedia Designers design information content for visual and audio communication, publication and display using print, film, electronic, digital and other forms of visual and audio media. They create special effects, animation, or other visual images for use in computer games, movies, music videos, print media and advertisements.
pay_rationale: Skilled graphic and multimedia designers earn moderately above the average for regular wage or salaried professionals in India.
outlook_rationale: Digital transformation, booming e-commerce, and the growing Indian digital media and entertainment industry will drive strong demand for multimedia designers.
exposure_rationale: Generative AI tools are rapidly transforming digital design, image creation, and animation workflows, though human creativity and client coordination remain essential.

title: Generalist Medical Practitioners
description: Generalist Medical Practitioners diagnose, treat and prevent illness, disease, injury, and other physical and mental impairments and maintain general health in humans through application of the principles and procedures of modern medicine. They do not limit their practice to certain disease categories or methods of treatment, and may assume responsibility for the provision of continuing and comprehensive medical care to individuals, families and communities
pay_rationale: Generalist medical practitioners command higher earnings compared to the average regular wage worker due to specialized medical training.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by increasing healthcare access, government initiatives, and a growing population needing primary healthcare services across India.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist in medical diagnosis and record-keeping, but the core requirement of physical examination, clinical judgment, and direct patient interaction limits direct automation.

title: Specialist Medical Practitioners
description: Specialist Medical Practitioners diagnose, treat and prevent illness, disease, injury, and other physical and mental impairments in humans, using specialized testing, diagnostic, medical, surgical, physical and psychiatric techniques, through application of the principles and procedures of modern medicine. They specialize in certain disease categories, types of patient or methods of treatment and may conduct medical education and research in their chosen areas of specialization.
pay_rationale: Specialist medical practitioners command significantly higher earnings compared to the general average for regular wage/salaried professionals due to long training and high skill requirements.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of healthcare infrastructure, rising health consciousness, and increasing prevalence of lifestyle diseases drive strong demand for medical specialists in India.
exposure_rationale: AI will assist with diagnostics, imaging analysis, and research, but the core of clinical judgment, physical examination, and patient interaction remains deeply human.

title: Nursing Professionals
description: Nursing Professionals provide treatment, support and care services for people who are in need of nursing care due to the effects of ageing, injury, illness or other physical or mental impairment, or potential risks to health. They assume responsibility for the planning and management of the care of patients, including the supervision of other health care workers, working autonomously or in teams with medical doctors and others in the practical application of preventive and curative measures.
pay_rationale: Qualified nursing professionals earn slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried employees in the services sector.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by an expanding healthcare sector, growing elderly population, and rising healthcare investments in India.
exposure_rationale: Nursing requires direct physical presence, hands-on patient care, and real-time clinical judgment that cannot be replaced by AI, though administrative tasks may be streamlined.

title: Traditional and Complementary Medicine Professionals
description: Traditional and Complementary Medicine Professionals prevent, diagnose and treat illness, disease, injury, and other physical and mental impairments and maintain general health in humans by applying knowledge, skills and practices acquired through extensive study of the theories, beliefs and experiences, originating in specific cultures.
pay_rationale: Licensed professionals in traditional medicine generally earn slightly above the average for regular wage or self-employed professionals depending on their clinical practice.
outlook_rationale: Traditional and complementary medicine (like Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, and Homeopathy in India) is experiencing strong policy support and rising consumer demand, driving solid employment growth.
exposure_rationale: This occupation relies heavily on interpersonal, clinical judgment, and traditional diagnostic practices that require direct physical presence and patient interaction.

title: Paramedical Practitioners
description: Paramedical Practitioners provide advisory, diagnostic, curative and preventive medical services for humans more limited in scope and complexity than those carried out by medical doctors. They work autonomously, or with limited supervision of medical doctors, and apply advanced clinical procedures for treating and preventing diseases, injuries and other physical or mental impairments common to specific communities.
pay_rationale: Earns slightly above the average for regular wage healthcare workers due to specialized paramedical training.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by healthcare expansion in semi-urban and rural areas of India to bridge the shortage of doctors.
exposure_rationale: AI will assist with diagnostics and record-keeping, but the core work requires direct physical examination, patient interaction, and clinical judgment.

title: Veterinarians
description: Veterinarians diagnose, prevent and treat diseases, injuries and dysfunctions of animals. They may provide care to a wide range of animals or specialize in the treatment of a particular animal group or in a particular specialty area, or provide professional services to commercial firms producing biological and pharmaceutical products.
pay_rationale: Qualified veterinarians earn above the average regular salaried income due to specialized professional training.
outlook_rationale: Growth is driven by rising pet ownership, modernization of the dairy and livestock sectors, and increasing awareness of animal health in India.
exposure_rationale: Veterinary medicine relies heavily on physical examination, surgical procedures, and hands-on animal care, limiting direct automation by AI.

title: Dentists
description: Dentists diagnose, treat and prevent diseases, injuries and abnormalities of the teeth, mouth, jaws and associated tissues by applying the principles and procedures of modern dentistry. They use a broad range of specialized diagnostic, surgical and other techniques to promote and restore oral health.
pay_rationale: Qualified dentists typically earn above the average for regular wage or self-employed professionals due to specialized medical training.
outlook_rationale: Growing health consciousness, rising disposable incomes, and increasing access to dental care in urban and semi-urban India are driving strong demand for dental professionals.
exposure_rationale: Dentistry is fundamentally a hands-on clinical and surgical occupation requiring physical presence and manual dexterity, meaning AI can only assist with administrative and diagnostic imaging tasks.

title: Pharmacists
description: Pharmacists store, preserve, compound, and dispense medicinal products and counsel on the proper use and adverse effects of drugs and medicines following prescriptions issued by medical doctors and other health professionals. They contribute to researching, testing preparing, prescribing and monitoring medicinal therapies for optimising human health.
pay_rationale: Qualified pharmacists earn slightly above the average regular salaried worker due to their specialized healthcare training and professional licensing requirements.
outlook_rationale: Growth is driven by an expanding healthcare sector, rising pharmaceutical retail chains, and increased emphasis on clinical pharmacy services across India.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with inventory management, prescription verification, and drug interaction checks, but the core duties of compounding, dispensing, and patient counseling require physical presence and human interaction.

title: Environmental and Occupational Health and Hygiene Professionals
description: Environmental and Occupational Health and Hygiene Professionals assess, plan and implement programmes to recognize, monitor and control environmental factors that can potentially affect human health, to ensure safe and healthy working conditions, and to prevent disease or injury caused by chemical, physical, radiological and biological agents or ergonomic factors.
pay_rationale: As specialized technical professionals with higher education requirements, they earn above the average for regular wage-salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Increasing industrialization, stricter environmental regulations, and a growing focus on workplace safety and occupational health in India are driving demand for these professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist in analyzing environmental data, compliance reporting, and risk assessment models, but the role requires on-site inspections, physical monitoring, and direct engagement with workers and management.

title: Physiotherapists
description: Physiotherapists assess, plan and implement rehabilitative programmes that improve or restore human motor functions, maximize movement ability, relieve pain syndromes, and treat or prevent physical challenges associated with injuries, diseases and other impairments. They apply a broad range of physical therapies and techniques such as movement, ultrasound, heating, laser and other techniques.
pay_rationale: Qualified physiotherapists earn moderately above the average for regular wage or salaried professionals in the healthcare sector.
outlook_rationale: The demand for healthcare and rehabilitation services in India is surging due to an aging population, rising lifestyle diseases, and greater health awareness.
exposure_rationale: Physiotherapy is a hands-on, patient-centric profession requiring physical assessment and manual techniques, meaning AI can only assist with administrative tasks or exercise programming.

title: Dieticians and Nutritionists
description: Dieticians and Nutritionists assess, plan and implement programmes to enhance the impact of food and nutrition on human health.
pay_rationale: Professionals in this field typically earn slightly above the average for regular wage or salaried professionals due to specialized domain knowledge.
outlook_rationale: Rising health consciousness, lifestyle diseases, and a growing fitness industry in urban India are driving increased demand for qualified nutrition professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with generating meal plans and analyzing nutritional data, but direct human consultation, empathetic counseling, and clinical assessment require human presence and judgment.

title: Audiologists and Speech Therapists
description: Audiologists and Speech Therapists evaluate, manage and treat physical disorders affecting human hearing, speech, communication and swallowing. They prescribe corrective devices or rehabilitative therapies for hearing loss, speech disorders, and related sensory and neural problems and provide counselling on hearing safety and communication performance.
pay_rationale: Specialized healthcare professionals command earnings higher than the average regular wage worker due to required domain expertise.
outlook_rationale: Rising awareness of neurodevelopmental disorders, geriatric care needs, and general healthcare expansion in India are driving increased demand for specialized therapy professionals.
exposure_rationale: Audiologists and speech therapists rely heavily on direct, physical patient interaction, clinical evaluations, and hands-on therapy, meaning AI can only assist with administrative or diagnostic support.

title: Optometrists and Ophthalmic Opticians
description: Optometrists and Ophthalmic Opticians provide diagnosis, management and treatment services for disorders of the eyes and visual system. They counsel on eye care and prescribe optical aids or other therapies for visual disturbance.
pay_rationale: Professional eye care specialists earn moderately above the average regular wage worker due to specialized clinical training.
outlook_rationale: Growing demand for eye care services driven by increasing screen time, aging populations, and rising healthcare access in India.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist in diagnostic imaging analysis, but the hands-on physical examination, personalized fitting of optical aids, and patient interaction require direct human presence.

title: Health Professionals, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This unit group covers health professionals not classified elsewhere in sub-major group 22, Health professionals. For instance, the group includes occupations such as podiatrist, occupational therapist and other health professionals.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals requiring advanced training, their earnings are higher than the general average for regular wage/salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Demand for specialized healthcare services is rising rapidly in India due to aging demographics, increasing health awareness, and the expansion of the healthcare sector.
exposure_rationale: Specialized health professions like occupational therapists and podiatrists require hands-on physical therapy, clinical evaluation, and direct patient interaction, limiting AI to administrative tasks.

title: University and Higher Education Teachers
description: University and Higher Education Teachers prepare and deliver lectures and conduct tutorials in one or more subjects within a prescribed course of study at a university or other higher educational institution. They conduct research, and prepare scholarly papers and books.
pay_rationale: University and higher education teachers earn above the average for regular wage/salaried employees due to specialized qualifications.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of higher education institutions and rising enrollment rates in India will continue to drive steady demand for qualified faculty members.
exposure_rationale: AI will significantly assist with research, lecture preparation, and administrative tasks, but core teaching, mentoring, and qualitative evaluation require direct human presence and judgment.

title: Secondary Education Teachers
description: Secondary Education Teachers teach one or more subjects at secondary education level, excluding subjects intended to prepare students for employment in specific occupational areas.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage-salaried employees due to the requirement of specialized graduate or postgraduate qualifications.
outlook_rationale: Expanding secondary education enrollment and increased government and private focus on formal schooling continue to drive strong demand for qualified teachers in India.
exposure_rationale: AI tools significantly assist with lesson planning, content creation, and administrative tasks, but classroom instruction, student engagement, and behavioral management remain fundamentally human.

title: Primary School Teachers
description: Primary School Teachers teach a range of subjects at the primary education level.
pay_rationale: Primary school teachers in regular wage settings earn slightly above the national average for salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Demand for primary education remains steady due to rising emphasis on foundational literacy and schooling access in India, though constrained by government budget allocations.
exposure_rationale: AI will assist with lesson planning, grading, and personalized learning materials, but the core delivery requires human presence, empathy, and classroom management.

title: Early Childhood Educators
description: Early Childhood Educators promote the social, physical, and intellectual development of children below primary school age through the provision of educational and play activities.
pay_rationale: Entry-level preschool teachers in India generally earn slightly below the average for regular wage-salaried professionals due to the informal nature of many early education centers.
outlook_rationale: Rising urbanization and increasing participation of dual-income parents in the workforce are driving strong demand for preschools and creches across India.
exposure_rationale: Early childhood education relies heavily on interpersonal engagement, emotional care, and physical supervision, which AI cannot automate.

title: Education Method Specialists
description: Education Method Specialists conduct research and develop or advise on teaching methods, courses and aids. They review and examine teachers' work, the functioning of educational institutions and the results achieved and recommend changes and improvement.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals with advanced educational qualifications working in advisory or supervisory roles, their pay is higher than the average salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Growing emphasis on educational reform, quality enhancement, and modernization of teaching methods in Indian schools and higher education institutions drives demand.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can assist in curriculum design, research, and analysis of educational outcomes, but the advisory, evaluative, and human-centric aspects require significant personal judgment.

title: Special Needs Teachers
description: Special Needs Teachers teach children who are differently-abled (mentally or physically), young persons or adults or those with learning difficulties or other special needs. They promote the social, emotional, intellectual and physical development of their students.
pay_rationale: Specialized training commands a slight premium over standard teaching roles within the regular wage category.
outlook_rationale: Growing awareness of neurodiversity and inclusive education in India is driving higher demand for specialized educators in schools and therapy centers.
exposure_rationale: Special needs teaching relies heavily on human empathy, personalized physical interaction, and real-time behavioral observation, leaving little room for direct automation.

title: Other Arts Teachers
description: Other Arts Teachers teach students in the practice, theory and performance of dance, drama, visual and other arts (excluding music) outside the mainstream primary, secondary and higher education systems, but may provide private or small group tuition as an extracurricular activity in association with mainstream educational institutions.
pay_rationale: Earnings typically align slightly above average for self-employed or specialized professionals depending on private clientele and location.
outlook_rationale: Rising disposable incomes and a growing emphasis on extracurricular activities and holistic development in urban India are fueling demand for arts tuition.
exposure_rationale: Arts instruction relies heavily on physical demonstration, real-time feedback, and interpersonal engagement, which AI cannot replicate directly.

title: Information Technology Trainers
description: Information Technology Trainers develop, schedule and conduct training programmes and courses for computer and other information technology users outside the mainstream primary, secondary and higher education systems.
pay_rationale: Specialized IT trainers earn moderately above the average for regular wage and salaried employees due to specialized technical knowledge.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand for upskilling and continuous technical education in India's booming digital and tech-enabled service sectors drives high growth for IT trainers.
exposure_rationale: While IT trainers teach technical concepts that may increasingly involve AI tools, their core role relies on human-centric instruction, curriculum delivery, and interactive guidance.

title: Teaching Professionals, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This unit group covers Teaching Professionals not classified elsewhere. For instance, the group includes those who provide private tuition in subjects other than foreign languages and the arts, and those who provide educational counselling to students.
pay_rationale: Specialized private tutors and educational counselors typically earn moderately above the average regular salaried or self-employed benchmark due to specialized knowledge.
outlook_rationale: Growing emphasis on specialized education, competitive exams, and career counseling in India drives steady demand for private tutoring and educational guidance.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can assist in educational counseling and personalized tutoring content, but the core delivery relies heavily on interpersonal communication and human guidance.

title: Accountants
description: Accountants plan, organize and administer accounting systems for individuals and establishments. Some occupations classified here examine and analyse the accounting and financial records of individuals and establishments to ensure accuracy and compliance with established accounting standards and procedures.
pay_rationale: Qualified accountants earn moderately above the average for regular wage or salaried workers due to required specialized financial knowledge.
outlook_rationale: Demand for accounting professionals remains strong due to formalization of the economy, business expansion, and complex compliance requirements like GST.
exposure_rationale: Accounting involves structured digital financial data processing, making it highly susceptible to automation through modern accounting software and AI-driven bookkeeping tools.

title: Financial and Investment Advisors
description: Financial and Investment Advisers develop financial plans for individuals and organizations, and invest and manage funds on their behalf.
pay_rationale: Specialized knowledge and management of significant capital allow financial advisors to earn well above the standard salaried worker average.
outlook_rationale: Growing formalization of household savings and rising disposable incomes in India are driving strong demand for professional financial advisory services.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can efficiently generate portfolio recommendations and financial models, but human trust, personalized advice, and regulatory compliance remain essential.

title: Personal and Careers Professionals
description: Personnel and Careers Professionals provide professional business services related to personnel policies, such as employee recruitment or development, occupational analysis and vocational guidance.
pay_rationale: Professional corporate roles in human resources and careers typically command salaries above the national average for regular wage workers.
outlook_rationale: Strong corporate growth, expanding startup ecosystems, and increased focus on talent management and skill development in India will drive demand for HR and career professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI tools are increasingly used for resume screening, candidate sourcing, and automated career counseling, but human judgment remains essential for interviews, coaching, and strategic HR decisions.

title: Training and Staff Development Professionals
description: Training and Staff Development Professionals plan, develop, implement and evaluate training and development programmes to ensure management and staff acquire the skills and develop the competencies required by organizations to meet organizational objectives.
pay_rationale: Specialized knowledge workers in corporate environments command higher salaries than the average regular wage worker.
outlook_rationale: Strong growth driven by expanding corporate sectors, IT services, and emphasis on continuous upskilling and professional development in India.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist in content creation, curriculum design, and automated assessment, but delivery, facilitation, and customized coaching require strong human interaction.

title: Advertising and Marketing Professionals
description: Advertising and Marketing Professionals develop and co-ordinate advertising strategies and campaigns, determine the market for new goods and services, and identify and develop market opportunities for new and existing goods and services.
pay_rationale: Skilled advertising and marketing professionals in corporate or agency settings earn significantly above the average regular salaried wage.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of digital commerce, social media, and competitive consumer markets in India drives strong demand for marketing professionals.
exposure_rationale: Advertising and marketing heavily involve digital content creation, data analysis, and campaign planning, which are increasingly automated or augmented by generative AI.

title: Public Relations Professionals
description: Public Relations Professionals plan, develop, implement and evaluate information and communication strategies that create an understanding and a favourable view of businesses and other organizations, their goods and services, and their role in the community.
pay_rationale: Earnings for PR professionals in corporate environments typically exceed the national average for regular wage-salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of corporate communication, digital media, and brand management in India's growing economy supports steady employment growth.
exposure_rationale: PR professionals rely heavily on digital content creation, media monitoring, and strategic communication, areas where generative AI tools are becoming increasingly capable.

title: Technical and Medical Sales Professional (excluding
description: ICT) Technical and Medical Sales Professionals (excluding ICT) represent companies in selling a range of industrial, medical and pharmaceutical goods and services to industrial, business, professional and other establishments.
pay_rationale: Sales professionals typically earn above the regular salaried average due to commissions and the specialized technical knowledge required.
outlook_rationale: Demand for medical, pharmaceutical, and industrial goods is expanding rapidly in India due to healthcare sector growth and industrialization.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with customer relationship management, market research, and automated lead generation, but the core sales process relies heavily on human relationship-building, negotiation, and physical presence.

title: System Analysts
description: Systems Analysts conduct research, analyse and evaluate client information technology requirements, procedures or problems, and develop and implement proposals, recommendations, and plans to improve current or future information systems.
pay_rationale: As skilled IT professionals in the regular wage category, system analysts earn significantly above the average salary for salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by rapid digital transformation, cloud adoption, and IT modernization across Indian enterprises and global capability centers.
exposure_rationale: Systems analysis involves heavy knowledge work and digital output, but requires complex human judgment, client interaction, and overarching architectural design that AI currently augments rather than fully replaces.

title: Software Developers
description: Software Developers research, analyse and evaluate requirements for existing or new software applications and operating systems, and design, develop, test and maintain software solutions to meet these requirements.
pay_rationale: Software developers earn significantly above the national average for regular wage and salaried workers due to high specialized skill demand.
outlook_rationale: India's robust IT sector and digital economy transformation continue to drive strong demand for skilled software developers.
exposure_rationale: Software development is highly digital and code-based, making it very susceptible to automation and immense productivity gains through generative AI tools.

title: Application Programmers
description: Application Programmers write and maintain programmable code outlined in technical instructions and specifications for software applications and operating systems.
pay_rationale: Application programmers command well-above-average salaries compared to the general regular wage category in India.
outlook_rationale: India's booming IT services sector and expanding digital economy continue to drive strong demand for skilled software professionals.
exposure_rationale: Application programming is fundamentally digital work where generative AI tools significantly accelerate coding, debugging, and software development tasks.

title: Software and Application Developers and Analysts, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This unit group covers software and applications developers and analysts not classified elsewhere in minor group 251, Software and applications developers and analysts. For instance, the group includes those professionals specialising in quality assurance including software testing.
pay_rationale: As skilled technical professionals in the high-demand IT sector, their earnings significantly exceed the average for regular wage and salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: India's booming IT and software services sector drives strong, continuous demand for specialized developers, quality assurance professionals, and analysts.
exposure_rationale: While software testing and miscellaneous development tasks are increasingly augmented by AI code-generation and testing tools, human oversight and analytical problem-solving remain essential.

title: Database Designers and Administrators
description: Database Designers and Administrators design, develop, control, maintain and support the optimal performance and security of databases.
pay_rationale: As specialized technical professionals in the high-demand IT sector, database designers earn substantially above the average regular salaried wage in India.
outlook_rationale: Driven by rapid digitization, cloud adoption, and massive data generation across Indian industries, demand for database professionals remains exceptionally strong.
exposure_rationale: Database design and administration involve significant digital and structured knowledge work where AI can automate routine SQL writing, query optimization, and monitoring tasks.

title: Systems Administrators
description: Systems Administrators develop, control, maintain and support the optimal performance and security of information technology systems.
pay_rationale: Technical expertise commands a premium well above the average regular wage in India's booming tech ecosystem.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by the rapid expansion of India's digital infrastructure, cloud adoption, and IT services sector.
exposure_rationale: Systems administration involves heavy computer-based work where routine tasks like log monitoring, script execution, and incident triage are increasingly automated by AI and cloud orchestration tools.

title: Computer Network Professionals
description: Computer Network Professionals research, analyse and recommend strategies for network architecture and development, implement, manage, maintain and configure network hardware and software, and monitor, troubleshoot and optimise performance.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills place these professionals significantly above the national average for salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by the rapid expansion of cloud computing, 5G rollouts, and enterprise digitization across India.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can automate routine network monitoring, configuration, and basic troubleshooting, but hands-on hardware implementation and architectural judgment still require human professionals.

title: Lawyers
description: Lawyers give clients legal advice on a wide variety of subjects, draw up legal documents, represent clients before administrative boards or tribunals and plead cases or conduct prosecutions in courts of justice, or instruct barristers to plead in higher courts of justice.
pay_rationale: Lawyers typically earn more than the average regular wage worker in India, though earnings vary widely based on experience and court practice.
outlook_rationale: Demand for legal services is growing steadily in India due to increasing economic activity, corporate compliance needs, and litigation volume.
exposure_rationale: AI is increasingly capable of legal research, document drafting, and contract review, significantly changing the nature of legal knowledge work.

title: Judges
description: Judges preside over civil and criminal proceedings in courts of law.
pay_rationale: Judges are senior government officials who receive well-structured, higher-tier public sector compensation compared to the average regular wage worker.
outlook_rationale: Employment growth will be driven by ongoing judicial reforms, efforts to reduce the immense backlog of court cases in India, and the expansion of the legal system.
exposure_rationale: Judicial decision-making relies heavily on human judgment, legal interpretation, courtroom presence, and ethical reasoning, which AI cannot automate. AI may assist with case research and document review, but the core function remains deeply interpersonal and analytical.

title: Legal Professionals, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This unit group covers legal professionals not classified elsewhere in Minor group 261, Legal professionals. For instance, the group includes those who perform legal functions other than pleading or prosecuting cases or presiding over judicial proceedings.
pay_rationale: Specialized legal professionals generally earn well above the average for regular wage or salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Demand for specialized legal compliance and advisory services is growing in India due to increasing regulatory complexity and corporate formalisation.
exposure_rationale: Legal research, document drafting, and contract review tasks performed by these professionals are heavily exposed to automation and generative AI tools.

title: Archivists and Curators
description: Archivists and Curators collect, appraise and ensure the safekeeping and preservation of the contents of archives, artefacts and records of historical, cultural, administrative and artistic interest, and of art and other objects. They plan, devise and implement systems for the safekeeping of records and historically valuable documents.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage-salaried professionals due to the specialized knowledge and higher education required.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth is expected in India due to increasing investment in museums, cultural heritage preservation, and digital archiving of institutional records.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with cataloging, digitization, and metadata generation, but physical preservation, curation, and exhibition design require human judgment and physical presence.

title: Librarians and Related Information Professionals
description: Librarians and Related Information Professionals collect, select, develop, organize and maintain library collections and other information repositories, organize and control other library services and provide information for users.
pay_rationale: Qualified information professionals earn slightly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to required formal qualifications.
outlook_rationale: Traditional physical libraries are seeing slower growth, but institutional demand for digital information management provides a modest positive outlook.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can efficiently handle cataloging, information retrieval, and patron query assistance, moderately shifting the role toward curation and digital management.

title: Economists
description: Economists conduct research, monitor data, analyse information and prepare reports and plans to resolve economic and business problems and develop models to analyse, explain and forecast economic behaviour and patterns. They provide advice to business, interest groups and governments to formulate solutions to present or projected economic and business problems.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals with advanced degrees, economists earn significantly higher than the average regular wage/salaried worker in India.
outlook_rationale: Demand for economic analysis, market research, and policy advisory is growing in both corporate and government sectors as India's economy expands.
exposure_rationale: Economists rely heavily on data analysis, econometric modelling, and report writing, which can be significantly augmented and partially automated by advanced AI tools.

title: Sociologists, Anthropologists and Related Professionals
description: Sociologists, Anthropologists and Related Professionals investigate and describe the structure of societies, the origin and evolution of societies, and the interdependence between environmental conditions and human activities. They provide advice on the practical application of their findings in the formulation of economic and social policies.
pay_rationale: Professionals in academic, research, and policy advisory roles typically earn moderately above the average for regular wage/salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth is expected driven by increased demand for social research, public policy evaluation, and development sector insights in India.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can assist significantly with qualitative and quantitative data analysis, literature reviews, and report generation, though human fieldwork, interpretation, and policy formulation remain essential.

title: Philosophers, Historians and Political Scientists
description: Philosophers, historians and political scientists conduct research into the nature of human experience and existence, phases or aspects of human history, and political structures, movements and behaviour. They document and report on findings to inform and guide political and individual actions.
pay_rationale: As specialized professionals, their earnings exceed the average for regular wage and salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Academic and research positions face moderate demand driven by educational expansion, though traditional roles grow slowly.
exposure_rationale: Much of their work involves text analysis, historical research, and writing, which are increasingly assisted or automated by generative AI tools.

title: Psychologists
description: Psychologists research into and study the mental processes and behaviour of human beings as individuals or in groups, and apply this knowledge to promote personal, social, educational or occupational adjustment and development.
pay_rationale: Qualified psychologists in clinical or corporate settings earn above the average regular wage for professionals.
outlook_rationale: Growing mental health awareness and rising urban stress in India are driving increased demand for professional psychological services.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with psychological assessment, administrative tasks, and psychoeducation, but human empathy, active listening, and complex emotional therapy remain inherently human.

title: Social Work and Counselling Professionals
description: Social Work and Counselling Professionals provide advice and guidance to individuals, families, groups, communities and organizations in response to social and personal difficulties. They assist clients to develop skills and access resources and support services needed to respond to issues arising from unemployment, poverty, disability, addiction, criminal and delinquent behaviour, marital and other problems.
pay_rationale: Qualified professionals in this field typically earn slightly above the average for regular wage or salaried workers in India due to required education.
