outlook_rationale: Growing mental health awareness and government welfare programs are increasing the demand for professional social workers and counselors in India.
exposure_rationale: The core of this occupation relies heavily on human empathy, interpersonal communication, and direct counseling, which cannot be automated by AI.

title: Religious Professionals
description: Religious Professionals function as perpetuators of sacred traditions, practices and beliefs. They conduct religious services, celebrate or administer the rites of a religious faith or denomination, provide spiritual and moral guidance and perform other
pay_rationale: Most religious professionals in India rely on community donations or modest institutional stipends, placing average earnings below the general salaried or professional average.
outlook_rationale: Demand for spiritual guidance and traditional rituals remains steady with population growth, though cultural shifts may slightly moderate formal roles.
exposure_rationale: Religious practices rely deeply on human presence, personal counselling, spiritual leadership, and emotional connection, which AI cannot replace.

title: Authors and Related Writers
description: Authors and Related Writers plan, research and write books, scripts, storyboards, plays, essays, speeches, manuals, specifications and other non- journalistic articles (excluding material for newspapers, magazines and other periodicals) for publication or presentation.
pay_rationale: Professional authors and specialized writers often earn moderately above the average for regular wage or self-employed categories depending on commercial success.
outlook_rationale: Demand for digital content, scripts, and specialized writing continues to grow, though competition and AI tools moderate traditional employment expansion.
exposure_rationale: Generative AI tools can assist with drafting, structuring, and brainstorming for various types of written content, heavily impacting the writing process.

title: Journalists
description: Journalists research, investigate, interpret and communicate news and public affairs through newspapers, television, radio and other media.
pay_rationale: Median earnings for journalists are somewhat higher than the general average for regular wage/salaried professionals in media and communication sectors.
outlook_rationale: Traditional print journalism is contracting, but digital media, regional news portals, and content creation are expanding, leading to modest overall employment growth.
exposure_rationale: Journalism involves significant digital content creation, research, and text processing, which are increasingly assisted or automated by generative AI tools.

title: Translators, Interpreters and Other Linguists
description: Translators, Interpreters and Other Linguists translate or interpret from one language into another and study the origin, development and structure of languages.
pay_rationale: Skilled translators and interpreters command above-average salaries due to specialized bilingual proficiency and technical domain knowledge.
outlook_rationale: Globalization, cross-border business, and digital content creation drive steady demand for multilingual professionals despite rapid advancements in machine translation.
exposure_rationale: While advanced AI translation tools handle routine text quickly, human translators and interpreters are still needed for specialized, culturally nuanced, and real-time communication work.

title: Visual Artists
description: Visual Artists create and execute works of art by sculpting, painting, drawing, creating cartoons, engraving or using other techniques.
pay_rationale: Earnings vary widely depending on commercial success, individual reputation, and freelance client portfolios.
outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by expanding digital media, advertising, and creative industries, though traditional fine arts face moderate competition from AI-generated imagery.
exposure_rationale: Generative AI tools can rapidly produce visual art, digital illustrations, and concepts, directly impacting digital creation processes.

title: Musicians, Singers and Composers
description: Musicians, singers and composers write, arrange, conduct and perform musical compositions.
pay_rationale: Earnings vary widely from modest gig-to-gig income for most to high earnings for established artists, averaging out near the regular professional level.
outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by the expanding digital media, streaming, live events, and entertainment sectors in India, though competition remains intense.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can generate compositions, lyrics, and audio tracks, but live performance, cultural interpretation, and human artistic collaboration remain vital and irreplaceable.

title: Dancers and Choreographers
description: Dancers and choreographers conceive and create or perform dances.
pay_rationale: Earnings vary widely from modest incomes for traditional folk artists to higher pay for commercial choreographers in the entertainment industry.
outlook_rationale: Growth will be supported by expanding media, entertainment, reality television, fitness trends, and cultural events in urban India.
exposure_rationale: Dances and choreography are fundamentally physical, creative, and culturally expressive arts that require human presence, emotion, and bodily execution.

title: Film, Stage and Related Directors and Producers
description: Film, Stage and Related Directors and Producers oversee and control the technical and artistic aspects of motion pictures, television or radio productions and stage shows.
pay_rationale: Successful directors and producers typically earn well above the standard professional or salaried averages due to project-based high returns.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of OTT platforms, regional cinema, digital advertising, and entertainment media in India is driving steady demand for content creators and directors.
exposure_rationale: AI tools increasingly assist with scriptwriting, storyboarding, and video editing, but the core directorial vision, stakeholder management, and live stage control require distinct human creativity and leadership.

title: Actors
description: Actors portray roles in motion pictures, television or radio productions and stage shows.
pay_rationale: Earnings for actors vary immensely, ranging from struggling artists to high earners, but successful professionals generally command above-average wages compared to standard salaried roles.
outlook_rationale: The rapid expansion of OTT platforms, regional cinema, and digital content creation in India continues to increase employment opportunities for actors.
exposure_rationale: While digital technology and generative AI impact visual effects, voice cloning, and scriptwriting, the core performance aspect requires live human presence, emotion, and physical enactment.

title: Announcers on Radio, Television and Other Media
description: Announcers on Radio, Television and Other media read news bulletins, conduct interviews, and make other announcements or introductions on radio, television, and in theatres and other establishments or media.
pay_rationale: Established media announcers typically earn more than the average regular wage/salaried worker due to specialized communication skills and media visibility.
outlook_rationale: While traditional television and radio face moderate growth, the expansion of digital media, podcasts, and regional OTT platforms creates new opportunities for announcers.
exposure_rationale: AI text-to-speech and automated avatar technologies can handle basic broadcasting, but live interviews, ad-libbing, and emotional resonance still require human presence.

title: Creative and Performing Artists, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This unit group covers all creative and performing artists not classified elsewhere. For instance, the group includes clowns, magicians, acrobats and other performing artists.
pay_rationale: Earnings for many independent performers and artists in unorganized segments tend to be modest and irregular.
outlook_rationale: Growth in entertainment, tourism, and digital content creation will steadily increase demand for live performers and artists.
exposure_rationale: Performers and artists rely heavily on physical skills, live presence, and human creativity, limiting direct AI automation.

title: Chemical and Physical Science Technicians
description: Chemical and Physical Science Technicians perform technical tasks to aid in research in chemistry, physics, geology, geophysics, meteorology and astronomy, and in the development of industrial, medical, military and other practical applications of research results.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried workers due to the technical and scientific skills required.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth is expected driven by expanding industrial manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and quality control testing laboratories in India.
exposure_rationale: AI will assist with data analysis, laboratory information management systems, and predictive modeling, but physical sample preparation and equipment operation remain hands-on.

title: Civil Engineering Technicians
description: Civil Engineering Technicians perform technical tasks in civil engineering research, design, construction, operation, maintenance and repair of buildings and other structures, such as water supply and wastewater treatment systems, bridges, roads, dams and airports.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage or salaried workers due to the technical and specialized nature of the role.
outlook_rationale: Rapid infrastructure development, urbanization, and construction booms across India are driving steady demand for skilled civil engineering technicians.
exposure_rationale: AI tools assist with drafting, structural calculations, and project management, but physical site visits, material testing, and on-site supervision remain essential.

title: Electrical Engineering Technicians
description: Electrical Engineering Technicians perform technical tasks to aid in electrical engineering research, and in the design, manufacture, assembly, construction, operation, maintenance and repair of electrical equipment, facilities and distribution systems.
pay_rationale: Slightly above average for regular wage-salaried workers due to specialized technical training and skills required.
outlook_rationale: Growing demand driven by infrastructure expansion, renewable energy integration, and industrialization across India.
exposure_rationale: AI will assist with diagnostics, design simulations, and maintenance scheduling, but the hands-on nature of electrical repair, installation, and field operations limits direct automation.

title: Electronics Engineering Technicians
description: Electronics Engineering Technicians perform technical tasks to aid in electronic research, and in the design, manufacture, assembly, construction, operation, maintenance and repair of electronic equipment.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills allow these workers to earn slightly above the average for regular wage or salaried technical support roles.
outlook_rationale: Strong government push for domestic electronics manufacturing (Make in India, semiconductor and PLI schemes) drives steady demand for skilled hardware technicians.
exposure_rationale: Electronics technicians involve hands-on hardware assembly, testing, and troubleshooting, though diagnostic software and AI-assisted troubleshooting tools moderately impact their workflow.

title: Mechanical Engineering Technicians
description: Mechanical Engineering Technicians perform technical tasks to aid in mechanical engineering research, and in the design, manufacture, assembly, construction, operation, maintenance and repair of machines, components and mechanical equipment.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills allow these workers to earn moderately above the average for regular wage and salaried employees in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by expanding manufacturing initiatives, industrial automation, and infrastructure development in India over the next decade.
exposure_rationale: Mechanical engineering technicians rely on physical inspection, hands-on assembly, and equipment maintenance where AI's impact is limited, though design and drafting tasks increasingly use computer-aided tools.

title: Chemical Engineering Technicians
description: Chemical Engineering Technicians perform technical tasks to aid in chemical engineering research, and in the design, manufacture, construction, operation, maintenance and repair of chemical plant.
pay_rationale: Technical specialists in chemical engineering command moderately higher wages than the average salaried worker due to specialized skills.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth is expected driven by expanding chemical manufacturing and industrial processing sectors in India.
exposure_rationale: AI and automation will assist with process simulation, data analysis, and plant monitoring, but physical inspection and maintenance of chemical plants still require hands-on presence.

title: Mining and Metallurgical Technicians
description: Mining and Metallurgical Technicians perform technical tasks to assist in research and experiments related to metallurgy, in improving methods of extracting solid minerals, oil and gas, and in the design, construction, operation, maintenance and repair of mines and mine installations, of systems for transporting and storing oil and natural gas, and for extraction of metals from ores.
pay_rationale: Technical specialists in mining and metallurgy earn moderately above the average regular wage due to specialized technical skills and hazardous working conditions.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth is expected driven by industrialization, infrastructure development, and demand for minerals, offset partially by increased technological efficiency.
exposure_rationale: AI and automation will increasingly assist in predictive maintenance, data analysis for mineral extraction, and simulation of metallurgical processes, though on-site technical and supervisory tasks remain hands-on.

title: Draughtspersons
description: Draughtspersons prepare technical drawings, maps and illustrations from sketches, measurements and other data, and copy final drawings and paintings onto printing plates.
pay_rationale: Requires specialized technical skills and software knowledge, commanding moderately higher wages than the average technical associate category.
outlook_rationale: Growth in real estate, infrastructure, and manufacturing will sustain demand, though design software efficiency limits headcount expansion.
exposure_rationale: Much of the work is computer-based using CAD software, making it highly susceptible to automation and productivity gains from AI design tools.

title: Physical and Engineering Science Technicians, Not Elsewhere Classified This
description: family covers Physical and Engineering Science Technicians not classified elsewhere. For instance, the group includes those who assist scientists and engineers engaged in developing procedures or conducting research on safety, biomedical, environmental or industrial and production engineering.
pay_rationale: Technical associate professionals with specialized training earn moderately above the average for regular wage-salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Demand is growing steadily due to industrial expansion, manufacturing growth, and increased focus on environmental and industrial safety standards in India.
exposure_rationale: These technicians perform specialized technical and physical support tasks in labs and industrial settings, which limits full digital automation, though data analysis tools and AI will increasingly assist their work.

title: Mining Supervisors
description: Mining supervisors oversee mining and quarrying operations and directly supervise and co-ordinate the activities of miners working in underground and surface mines and quarries.
pay_rationale: Supervisory responsibilities and technical expertise in the mining sector command wages moderately above the average regular salaried worker in India.
outlook_rationale: Demand for minerals and infrastructure materials supports steady mining activity, though modernization may temper headcount growth.
exposure_rationale: Mining supervisors perform on-site coordination, safety checks, and direct oversight of operations, which requires physical presence and real-time judgment.

title: Manufacturing Supervisors
description: Manufacturing Supervisors co-ordinate and supervise the activities of Process Control Technicians, Machine Operators, Assemblers, and other Manufacturing Labourers.
pay_rationale: As skilled technical supervisors in regular wage/salaried employment, their earnings are moderately higher than the average wage employee.
outlook_rationale: Driven by government initiatives like 'Make in India' and the gradual expansion of domestic manufacturing and assembly plants, demand for floor supervisors is expected to grow steadily.
exposure_rationale: AI and automation tools can assist with scheduling, quality control monitoring, and workflow optimization, but the role fundamentally requires real-time physical supervision, troubleshooting of machinery, and interpersonal management on the shop floor.

title: Construction Supervisors
description: Construction Supervisors, co-ordinate, supervise and schedule the activities of workers engaged in the construction and repair of buildings and structures.
pay_rationale: Supervisory roles in construction command a moderate premium over standard regular wage earnings due to specialized technical oversight.
outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization and large-scale infrastructure investments in India are driving high demand for construction supervisors.
exposure_rationale: Construction supervision relies heavily on on-site physical presence, coordination, and real-time decision-making, which AI cannot automate.

title: Power Production Plant Operators
description: Power-production Plant Operators operate, monitor and maintain switchboards and related equipment in electrical control centres which control the production and distribution of electric or other power in transmission networks. The equipment operated includes reactors, turbines, generators and other auxiliary equipment in electrical power generating stations.
pay_rationale: Technical expertise and responsibility for critical infrastructure place these operators well above the average regular salaried worker's pay.
outlook_rationale: Expanding power generation capacity and infrastructure development in India drive steady demand for trained plant operators.
exposure_rationale: Power plant operations increasingly rely on automated control systems and AI-driven monitoring, but critical safety interventions and physical equipment management still require human presence.

title: Incinerator and Water-Treatment Plant Operators
description: Incinerator and Water-Treatment Plant Operators monitor and operate computerized control systems and related equipment in solid and liquid waste treatment plants to regulate the treatment and disposal of sewage and wastes, and in water filtration and treatment and distribution of water.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to the technical skills required to operate computerized treatment plants.
outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization and government initiatives for water treatment, sanitation, and waste management in India are driving increased demand for these plant operators.
exposure_rationale: While the role involves monitoring computerized control systems, physical operation, maintenance, and real-time troubleshooting of plant equipment require a human presence.

title: Chemical Processing Plant Controllers
description: Chemical processing plant controllers operate and monitor chemical plants and adjust and maintain, processing units and equipment which distil, filter, separate, heat or refine chemicals.
pay_rationale: Requires specialized technical skills and responsibility for industrial safety, commanding a premium over the average salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Growth will be supported by ongoing expansion in India's chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing sectors.
exposure_rationale: Plant controllers rely heavily on automated control systems and SCADA, but physical monitoring, safety interventions, and troubleshooting require human presence.

title: Petroleum and Natural Gas Refining Plant Operators
description: Petroleum and Natural Gas Refining Plant Operators operate and monitor plants and adjust and maintain processing units and equipment which refine, distil and treat petroleum, petroleum-based products and by-products, or natural gas.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills required for hazardous plant operations command wages well above the average regular salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Steady energy demand in India supports ongoing refining capacity, though efficiency gains will moderate net employment growth.
exposure_rationale: While the physical plant operations require on-site monitoring and manual intervention, control room processes are increasingly automated with digital monitoring systems.

title: Metal Production Process Controllers
description: Metal production process controllers operate and monitor multi-function process control machinery and equipment to control the processing of metal converting and refining furnaces, metal- rolling mills, metal heat-treating, or metal- extrusion plant.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical control in heavy industry commands a modest premium above the average regular salaried worker in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth in India's infrastructure and manufacturing sectors will drive steady demand for metal production, though increasing plant automation will moderate job creation.
exposure_rationale: While process control machinery is increasingly automated and computer-monitored, physical oversight and real-time operational intervention in heavy industrial metal plants limit full AI automation.

title: Process Control Technicians, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This family covers Process Control Technicians not classified elsewhere. For instance, the group includes those who operate multiple process control equipment in manufacturing assembly lines and paper an
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills in manufacturing command slightly higher wages than the average regular salaried worker in India.
outlook_rationale: As India expands its manufacturing sector through initiatives like Make in India, the demand for skilled technicians to oversee automated and semi-automated production lines is expected to grow steadily.
exposure_rationale: Process control technicians operate physical machinery and manufacturing equipment, which limits direct AI automation, though indirect monitoring and data analytics are increasingly supported by digital tools.

title: Life Science Technicians (Excluding Medical)
description: Life Science Technicians (except medical) provide technical support to life science professionals undertaking research, analysis and testing of living organisms, and development and application of products and processes resulting from research in areas such as natural resource management, environmental protection, plant and animal biology, microbiology, and cell and molecular biology.
pay_rationale: Technical specialists in research labs earn moderately above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to specialized skill requirements.
outlook_rationale: Employment in life sciences and research is growing steadily in India due to investments in biotechnology, agriculture research, and environmental protection.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with data analysis, documentation, and automated laboratory software, but physical sample collection, experiment setup, and lab work require human presence and manual skills.

title: Ship’s Engineers
description: Ships’ Engineers control and participate in the operation, maintenance and repair of mechanical, electrical and electronic equipment and machinery on board ship, or perform related supporting functions on shore.
pay_rationale: As specialized technical professionals with rigorous maritime certifications, ship engineers earn significantly higher than the average regular wage/salaried employee.
outlook_rationale: Growth is tied to the expansion of maritime trade, shipping fleets, and port infrastructure in India, ensuring steady demand for qualified marine engineers.
exposure_rationale: Ship's engineering is fundamentally hands-on and physical, involving heavy machinery operation, maintenance, and repair at sea, where AI can only assist with diagnostic monitoring rather than automate physical tasks.

title: Ship’s Deck Officers and Pilots
description: Ships’ deck officers and pilots command and navigate ships and similar vessels, and perform related functions on shore.
pay_rationale: Ship's deck officers and marine pilots are highly skilled professionals commanding significantly higher remuneration than the average salaried worker in India.
outlook_rationale: Steady growth is expected driven by expansion in maritime trade, shipping logistics, and India's growing port infrastructure.
exposure_rationale: While advanced navigation systems and AI-assisted collision avoidance are increasingly used, the core responsibilities of maritime command, pilotage, and vessel management require physical presence and complex human judgment.

title: Aircraft Pilots and Related Associate Professionals
description: Aircraft pilots and related associate professionals control the operation of mechanical, electrical and electronic equipment, in order to navigate aircraft for transporting passengers, mail and freight and perform related pre-flight and in-flight tasks.
pay_rationale: Commercial airline pilots command high compensation well above the average regular salaried worker due to specialized skills and high training barriers.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of India's aviation sector and airline fleets continues to drive strong long-term demand for qualified commercial pilots.
exposure_rationale: While modern aircraft utilize advanced autopilot and navigation systems, the physical operation, real-time safety management, and complex decision-making require continuous human presence.

title: Air Traffic Controllers
description: Air traffic Controllers direct aircraft movements in airspace and on the ground, using radio, radar and lighting systems, and provide information relevant to the operation of aircraft.
pay_rationale: Air traffic controllers are specialized technical professionals earning significantly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to the high-stakes nature of their responsibility.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of India's aviation sector, increasing numbers of airports, and rising air passenger traffic are driving strong demand for skilled air traffic controllers.
exposure_rationale: While air traffic management increasingly utilizes advanced automation and AI-assisted decision support systems, the critical safety-of-life decisions and real-time verbal communication with pilots remain inherently human-centric.

title: Medical Imaging and Therapeutic Equipment Technicians
description: Medical Imaging and Therapeutic Equipment Technicians test and operate radiographic, ultrasound and other medical imaging equipment to produce images of body structures for the diagnosis and treatment of injury, disease and other impairments. They may administer radiation treatments to patients under the supervision of a radiologist or other health professionals.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical training allows these professionals to earn moderately above the average for regular wage/salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of healthcare infrastructure, diagnostic centers, and hospitals in India is driving strong demand for technical healthcare roles.
exposure_rationale: AI assists in image analysis and quality control, but the physical operation of equipment and direct patient management remain hands-on.

title: Medical and Pathology Laboratory Technicians
description: Medical and Pathology Laboratory Technicians perform clinical tests on specimens of bodily fluids and tissues in order to obtain information about the health of a patient or cause of death.
pay_rationale: Medical laboratory technicians earn slightly above the average regular wage due to the specialized technical training required.
outlook_rationale: Healthcare expansion, rising diagnostic testing demand, and the growth of private pathology chains in India drive steady job creation for trained laboratory technicians.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist in analyzing digital pathology slides and laboratory data, but the collection, preparation, and initial processing of physical biological specimens still require hands-on human work.

title: Pharmaceutical Technicians and Assistants
description: Pharmaceutical Technicians and Assistants perform a variety of tasks associated with dispensing medicinal products under the guidance of a pharmacist or other health professional.
pay_rationale: Entry-level support roles in pharmacies typically earn slightly below the average for regular wage or salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth in the healthcare sector, expanding retail pharmacy chains, and increasing demand for medicines will drive steady job creation for pharmacy assistants in India.
exposure_rationale: AI and automation can assist with inventory management, prescription scanning, and record-keeping, but the physical dispensing and patient interaction require human oversight.

title: Medical and Dental Prosthetic Technicians
description: Medical and Dental Prosthetic Technicians design, fit, service and repair medical and dental devices and appliances following prescriptions or instructions established by a health professional. They may service a wide range of support instruments to correct physical medical or dental problems such as neck braces, orthopaedic splints, artificial limbs, hearing aids, arch supports, dentures, and dental crowns and bridges.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills required for prosthetic work command wages somewhat above the average regular salaried worker in India.
outlook_rationale: Demand for dental and medical prosthetics is expanding in India due to rising healthcare access, aging demographics, and growth in specialized medical tourism.
exposure_rationale: While CAD/CAM and 3D printing technologies are increasingly used in designing and manufacturing dental and medical prosthetics, the role still requires significant hands-on manual dexterity, fitting, and artisanal skill.

title: Nursing Associate Professionals
description: Nursing associate professionals provide basic nursing and personal care for people in need of such care due to effects of ageing, illness, injury, or other physical or mental impairment. They generally work under the supervision of, and in support of implementation of health care, treatment and referrals plans established by, medical, nursing and other health professionals.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried healthcare support workers due to specialized training.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by an expanding healthcare sector, growing elderly population, and increasing healthcare infrastructure in India.
exposure_rationale: Nursing care requires hands-on physical presence, personal interaction, and real-time patient assessment, which cannot be automated by AI.

title: Midwifery Associate Professionals
description: Midwifery associate professionals provide basic health care and advice before, during and after pregnancy and childbirth. They implement care, treatment and referral plans usually established by medical, midwifery and other health professionals.
pay_rationale: Midwifery associate professionals earn slightly above the average regular salaried worker due to specialized medical training.
outlook_rationale: Healthcare delivery expansion in India, particularly maternal and child health initiatives in rural and urban areas, drives a steady demand for associate health professionals.
exposure_rationale: The role requires hands-on clinical care, physical presence, and real-time interpersonal judgment during childbirth, making it largely immune to direct automation by AI.

title: Veterinary Technicians and Assistants
description: Veterinary Technicians and Assistants carry out advisory, diagnostic, preventive and curative veterinary tasks, more limited in scope and complexity than those carried out by, and with the guidance of, veterinarians. They care for animals under treatment and in temporary residence at veterinary facilities and assist veterinarians to perform procedures and operations.
pay_rationale: Pay is typically slightly below the average for regular wage-salaried healthcare support professionals due to the paraprofessional nature of the entry-level role.
outlook_rationale: Rising pet ownership, expansion of the organized dairy sector, and increased awareness of animal healthcare are driving demand for veterinary support staff.
exposure_rationale: The role requires hands-on physical care of animals, direct assistance in surgeries, and real-time observation, which AI cannot perform.

title: Dental Assistants and Therapists
description: Dental Assistants and therapists provide basic dental care services for the prevention and treatment of diseases and disorders of the teeth and mouth, as per care plans and procedures established by a dentist or other oral health professional.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage-salaried healthcare support workers due to specialized clinical skills.
outlook_rationale: Expanding healthcare access, rising disposable incomes, and a growing emphasis on oral hygiene in India are driving increased demand for dental support staff.
exposure_rationale: The role requires hands-on physical presence and direct patient care during dental procedures, leaving little room for AI replacement.

title: Dispensing Opticians
description: Dispensing opticians design fit and dispense optical lenses based on a prescription from an ophthalmologist or optometrist for the correction of reduced visual acuity. They service corrective eyeglasses, contact lenses, low-vision aids and other optical devices.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage or salaried technicians due to the specialized technical training required.
outlook_rationale: Growing healthcare awareness, increasing screen time, and rising demand for vision correction services in urban and semi-urban India support steady growth.
exposure_rationale: The role requires physical, hands-on interaction for fitting, adjusting, and dispensing eyewear and optical devices to patients, which AI cannot automate directly.

title: Medical Assistants
description: Medical Assistants perform basic clinical and administrative tasks to support patient care under the direct supervision of a medical practitioner or other health professional.
pay_rationale: Entry-level healthcare support workers typically earn somewhat below the overall average for regular wage and salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Healthcare expansion and increased demand for formalized clinical support staff in hospitals and clinics across India drive strong growth.
exposure_rationale: Medical assistants perform hands-on clinical and administrative support tasks that require physical presence and human interaction, limiting direct automation to paperwork.

title: Environmental and Occupational Health Inspectors and Associates
description: Environmental and Occupational Health Inspectors and Associates investigate the implementation of rules and regulations relating to environmental factors that may affect human health, safety in the workplace, and safety of processes for the production of goods and services. They may implement and evaluate programmes to restore or improve safety and sanitary conditions under the supervision of a health professional.
pay_rationale: Slightly above average for regular wage-salaried technical associate professionals due to the specialized knowledge required.
outlook_rationale: Growing emphasis on industrial safety, environmental regulations, and occupational health standards in developing sectors across India will drive moderate employment growth.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with data analysis, compliance tracking, and report generation, but fieldwork, site inspections, and physical investigations require human presence.

title: Securities and Finance Dealers and Brokers
description: Securities and Finance Dealers and Brokers buy and sell securities, stocks, bonds and other financial instruments, and deal on the foreign exchange, on spot, or on futures markets, on behalf of their own company or for customers on a commission basis. They recommend transactions to clients or senior management.
pay_rationale: As regular wage or salaried professionals in the financial sector, their specialized knowledge and performance-linked incentives place their earnings above the average salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Driven by India's expanding retail investor base, rising capital market participation, and growing financialization of household savings, demand for financial brokers and dealers is expected to grow strongly.
exposure_rationale: Much of transaction execution and market data analysis is increasingly automated through algorithmic trading platforms and robo-advisors, though client-facing advisory and negotiation roles still require human judgment.

title: Credit and Loan Officers
description: Credit and Loan Officers analyse and evaluate financial information on applications for credit and loans and determine approval or disapproval of the client for the credit or loan or recommend to management approval or disapproval.
pay_rationale: As regular wage-salaried professionals in the banking and financial sector, credit officers typically earn above the average wage for salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Strong demand driven by the rapid expansion of digital banking, microfinance, and retail credit in India, despite automation of routine approvals.
exposure_rationale: Credit and loan evaluation increasingly relies on automated credit scoring models, risk assessment algorithms, and AI-driven document verification, reducing the need for manual underwriting.

title: Statistical, Mathematical and Related Associate Professionals
description: Statistical, Mathematical and Actuarial Associate professionals assist in planning the collection, processing and presentation of statistical, mathematical or actuarial data and in carrying out these operations, usually working under the guidance of statisticians, mathematicians and actuaries.
pay_rationale: Requires specialized numerical and technical skills, commanding a moderate premium above the average regular wage salary.
outlook_rationale: Growing demand for data-driven decision making across finance, e-commerce, and corporate sectors will support moderate employment growth for associate professionals.
exposure_rationale: Much of the data collection, processing, and statistical tabulation work can be heavily automated or augmented by advanced analytics and AI tools.

title: Valuers and Loss Assessors
description: Valuers and Loss Assessors value property and various goods and assess losses covered by insurance policies.
pay_rationale: Requires specialized knowledge and certification, commanding earnings moderately above the average regular salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of the insurance sector, real estate financing, and commercial lending in India will drive steady demand for professional asset evaluation.
exposure_rationale: Valuers and loss assessors rely heavily on physical inspection, on-site estimation, and negotiation, which limit direct automation, though AI tools assist in property data analysis and report generation.

title: Insurance Representatives
description: Insurance representatives advise on and sell life, accident, automobile, liability, endowment, fire, marine and other types of insurance to new and established clients.
pay_rationale: Commission-based earnings and incentive structures for insurance sales often yield slightly above-average pay compared to general regular wage roles.
outlook_rationale: Insurance penetration in India is rising due to growing financial literacy and digital distribution platforms, driving demand for advisory services.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can increasingly handle lead generation, policy comparison, and routine customer queries, but the core sales and advisory role still requires human persuasion and trust.

title: Commercial Sales Representatives
description: Commercial sales representatives represent companies to sell various goods and services to businesses and other organizations and provide product specific information as required.
pay_rationale: Typically earn slightly above the average regular wage due to performance-linked incentives and commissions.
outlook_rationale: Expanding commercial activities, retail growth, and business expansion across India will drive steady demand for sales professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can assist with customer relationship management, market research, and communication, but field sales and business-to-business relationship building still require substantial human interaction and persuasion.

title: Buyers
description: Buyers buy goods and services for use or resale on behalf of industrial, commercial, government or other establishments and organizations.
pay_rationale: Regular wage/salaried buyers typically earn above the average for salaried employees due to the financial responsibilities involved.
outlook_rationale: Growth in organized retail, e-commerce, and manufacturing sectors in India will drive demand for procurement professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can automate supplier discovery, pricing analysis, and routine purchasing orders, but negotiation and vendor relationship management require human judgment.

title: Real Estate Agents and Property Managers
description: Real Estate Agents and Property Managers arrange the sale, purchase, rental and lease of real property, usually on behalf of clients and on a commission basis.
pay_rationale: Earnings heavily rely on commissions which can scale significantly with successful property deals in a growing market.
outlook_rationale: Urbanization, expansion of tier-2 and tier-3 cities, and a booming real estate market in India drive strong demand for property professionals.
exposure_rationale: AI platforms streamline property listings, market analysis, and customer matching, but the core tasks of physical property visits, negotiations, and relationship management remain inherently human.

title: Business Service Agents, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This family covers business services agents not classified elsewhere. For instance, the group includes those who establish business contacts, sell business services such as advertising space in the media, arrange contracts for performances of athletes, entertainers and artists, for the publication of books, the production of plays, or the recording, performance and sale of music and who sell property and goods by auction.
pay_rationale: Commission-based earnings and specialised networking skills often allow successful business agents to earn above the average regular or self-employed wage.
outlook_rationale: Growth in the media, entertainment, advertising, and real estate sectors in India will drive demand for specialized business service agents.
exposure_rationale: While client relationship management and networking require human presence, routine matching, administrative tasks, and advertising space sales are increasingly influenced by digital platforms and AI tools.

title: Office Supervisors
description: Office supervisors supervise and co- ordinate the activities of workers in division 3, Clerical support workers.
pay_rationale: Pay is higher than the average regular wage worker due to the supervisory responsibilities and administrative experience required.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth is expected alongside corporate expansion in India, though productivity tools may temper the number of supervisory roles needed per capita.
exposure_rationale: Office supervision heavily relies on digital communication, workflow management tools, and data reporting, which are increasingly automated or augmented by AI.

title: Customs and Border Inspectors
description: Customs and border inspectors check persons and vehicles crossing national borders to administer and enforce relevant government rules and regulations.
pay_rationale: Government customs inspectors enjoy stable salaries and allowances above the average for regular wage workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Employment growth will be steady due to increasing international trade and heightened security demands at borders, though tempered by the adoption of e-governance and automated scanning technologies.
exposure_rationale: AI and automation can assist with digital document verification, biometrics, and baggage scanning, but the core duties require physical inspection, physical presence, and real-time human judgment at borders.

title: Govt. Tax and Excise Officials
description: Government tax and excise officials examine tax returns, bills of sale and other documents to determine the type and amount of taxes, duties and other types of fees to be paid by individuals or businesses, referring exceptional or important cases to accountants, senior government officials or Managers.
pay_rationale: As mid-level government officials, their compensation exceeds the national average for regular salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Government efforts to broaden the tax base and digitize compliance drive steady moderate growth, though technology will moderate headcount expansion.
exposure_rationale: While tax audits and document examination involve cognitive judgment, the routine analysis of digital tax returns and bills of sale is increasingly being automated by AI and e-governance portals.

title: Government Social Benefits Officials
description: Government social benefits officials examine applications for government, financial or service programmes to determine eligibility and amount of benefit or appropriate services, referring exceptional or important cases to senior government officials or Managers.
pay_rationale: As regular wage government or public sector workers, these officials typically earn slightly above the average for salaried employees due to official pay scales.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth is expected as government welfare schemes expand in India, though digitization and automation may limit the total number of administrative roles needed.
exposure_rationale: AI can automate application processing and eligibility checks, but the role still requires human judgment, public interaction, and handling exceptional cases.

title: Police Inspectors and Detectives
description: Police inspectors and detectives investigate facts and circumstances relating to crimes committed in order to identify suspected offenders and obtain information not readily available or apparent concerning establishments or the circumstances and behaviour of persons, mostly in order to prevent crimes.
pay_rationale: Police inspectors earn significantly above the average regular wage/salaried employee benchmark in India due to their official rank and responsibilities.
outlook_rationale: Employment in law enforcement and public security in India is expected to grow steadily due to government investments in policing infrastructure and increasing urbanization.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with data analysis, surveillance, and forensic evidence processing, but the core investigative work requires physical presence, interrogation, law enforcement authority, and real-world tactical judgment.

title: Legal and Related Associate Professionals
description: Legal and related associate professionals perform support functions in courts of law or in law offices, provide services related to such legal matters as insurance contracts, the transferring of property and the granting of loans and other financial transactions or conduct investigations for clients.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average regular salaried category due to the specialized legal knowledge required.
outlook_rationale: Formalization of the economy, rising litigation, and corporate expansion in India drive steady demand for legal support services.
exposure_rationale: Legal associate professionals handle document preparation, investigations, and administrative tasks that are increasingly assisted by legal tech and AI tools, though human presence and judgment remain vital.

title: Social Work Associate Professionals
description: Social work associate professionals administer and implement social assistance programmes and community services and assist clients to deal with personal and social problems.
pay_rationale: Entry to mid-level associate roles in NGOs and government programs typically pay slightly below the overall average for regular wage workers.
outlook_rationale: Demand for social welfare and community development programs in India is rising as government and NGOs expand social safety nets.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with administrative tasks and case documentation, but the core work relies heavily on interpersonal communication, empathy, and fieldwork.

title: Athletes and Sports Players
description: Athletes and sport players participate in competitive sporting events. They train and compete, either individually or as part of a team, in their chosen sport.
pay_rationale: Successful professional athletes earn significantly more than the average salaried or self-employed worker, though income varies widely.
outlook_rationale: Increasing investments in sports leagues, fitness culture, and government initiatives in India are expanding opportunities for professional athletes.
exposure_rationale: Athletic performance relies heavily on physical training, skill, and real-time human execution, which cannot be automated by AI.

title: Sports Coaches, Instructors and Officials
description: Sports coaches, instructors and officials work with amateur and professional sportspersons to enhance performance, encourage greater participation in sport, and organize and officiate in sporting events according to established rules.
pay_rationale: Average earnings for sports coaches and instructors vary widely, with elite or institutional trainers earning moderately above the average regular wage.
outlook_rationale: Growing health consciousness, rising sports infrastructure, and increased commercialization of sports in India are driving demand for professional coaches and instructors.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with performance analytics and training schedules, but sports coaching and refereeing fundamentally rely on physical presence, human observation, and real-time interpersonal communication.

title: Fitness and Recreation Instructors, and Programme Leaders
description: Fitness and Recreation Instructors and Programme leaders lead, guide and instruct groups and individuals in recreational, fitness or outdoor adventure activities.
pay_rationale: Typical earnings for urban fitness instructors are slightly above the average for regular wage or self-employed service workers.
outlook_rationale: Rising health consciousness, expansion of gym chains, and increasing disposable incomes in urban India are driving strong demand for fitness professionals.
exposure_rationale: The role relies heavily on physical presence, real-time coaching, and interpersonal motivation, which cannot be replaced by AI.

title: Photographers
description: Photographers operate still cameras to photograph people, events, scenes, materials, products and other subjects.
pay_rationale: Earnings vary widely from freelance commercial work to local event photography, averaging slightly above the general self-employed baseline.
outlook_rationale: Demand for visual content in e-commerce, digital marketing, weddings, and social media continues to grow, supporting steady opportunities despite technological shifts.
exposure_rationale: AI enhances image editing, generation, and automated composition, but professional photography still relies heavily on physical presence, equipment handling, and real-time event capture.

title: Interior designers and decorators
description: Interior designers and decorators plan and design commercial, industrial, public, retail and residential building interiors to produce an environment tailored to a purpose, taking into consideration factors that enhance living and working environments and sales promotion. They co-ordinate and participate in their construction and decoration.
pay_rationale: Professionals with established portfolios and urban clientele typically earn significantly above the average regular wage.
outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization, rising disposable incomes, and a booming real estate and commercial sector in India are driving strong demand for interior design services.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can assist with 3D modeling, layout generation, and mood board creation, but the role heavily relies on physical site visits, client negotiations, and hands-on coordination.

title: Chefs
pay_rationale: Experienced chefs in commercial kitchens earn moderately above the average for regular wage or salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of the hospitality, tourism, and organized dining sectors in India is driving steady demand for skilled culinary professionals.
exposure_rationale: Chefs rely heavily on hands-on culinary skills, sensory judgment, and real-time kitchen management, which cannot be automated by AI.

title: Other Artistic and Cultural Associate Professionals
pay_rationale: Earnings can vary widely based on individual skill and commercial success, generally aligning slightly above average for salaried or freelance creative professionals.
outlook_rationale: Growing demand for entertainment, cultural events, digital content creation, and media in urban India will likely support steady employment growth.
exposure_rationale: Generative AI tools can assist with creative design, content creation, and artistic planning, but artistic and cultural associate professionals still require human presence, interpretation, and physical execution.

title: Information and Communication Technology User Support
description: Technicians Information and Communications Technology User Support Technicians provide technical assistance to users, either directly or by telephone, e-mail or other electronic means, including diagnosing and resolving issues and problems with software, hardware, computer peripheral equipment, networks, databases and the Internet, and providing guidance and support in the deployment, installation and maintenance of systems.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried workers due to the specialized technical skills required.
outlook_rationale: Rapid digitization across Indian enterprises and expanding IT infrastructure will continue to drive strong demand for technical support roles.
exposure_rationale: AI-powered chatbots and automated troubleshooting tools can resolve many standard IT support queries, though complex physical hardware issues and direct human guidance still require technician intervention.

title: Computer Network and Systems Technician
description: Computer Network and Systems Technicians establish, operate and maintain network and other data communication systems.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills place earnings moderately above the average for regular wage and salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Rapid digitisation, cloud adoption, and expansion of telecom and IT infrastructure in India drive steady demand for network technicians.
exposure_rationale: AI tools can automate routine network monitoring, diagnostics, and configuration tasks, but physical installation and hardware troubleshooting still require human presence.

title: Web Technician
description: Web Technicians maintain, monitor and support the optimal functioning of Internet and Intranet websites and web server hardware and software.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried technical support roles due to specialized technical skills required.
outlook_rationale: Rapid digitalization and the expansion of online services across Indian businesses continue to drive strong demand for web infrastructure professionals.
exposure_rationale: Web maintenance tasks such as monitoring, debugging, and routine server management are increasingly automated or assisted by AI tools, though human oversight remains essential.

title: Broadcasting and Audio-Visual Technicians
description: Broadcasting and Audio-Visual Technicians control technical functioning of equipment to record and edit images and sound and for transmitting radio and television broadcasts of images and sounds, and other types of telecommunication signals on land, sea or in aircraft.
pay_rationale: Requires specialized technical skills that command slightly above the average for regular wage or salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Growth in digital media, streaming platforms, and expanding regional television networks across India drive moderate demand for technicians.
exposure_rationale: While digital audio and video editing tools increasingly incorporate AI features, operating broadcast equipment and managing live transmission still require hands-on technical presence and real-time intervention.

title: Telecommunication Engineering Technicians
description: Telecommunications Engineering Technicians perform technical tasks connected with telecommunications engineering research, as well as with the design, manufacture, assembly, construction, operation, maintenance and repair of telecommunications systems.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills in networking and hardware maintenance command wages somewhat above the average regular salaried worker.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of 5G infrastructure, fiber-optic networks, and digital connectivity across India drives steady demand for telecom technicians.
exposure_rationale: While network monitoring and diagnostics are increasingly automated through AI tools, the physical installation, maintenance, and repair of telecommunications hardware require hands-on presence.

title: General Office Clerks
description: General Office Clerks perform a range of clerical and administrative tasks according to established procedures.
pay_rationale: Pay typically aligns with the average for regular wage and salaried employees in standard clerical positions.
outlook_rationale: Routine administrative and clerical roles face strong downward pressure on employment growth as organizations digitize and automate back-office workflows.
exposure_rationale: General office tasks such as data entry, scheduling, document sorting, and routine correspondence are prime targets for automation through LLMs and enterprise workflow software.

title: Secretaries (General)
description: Secretaries (General) use typewriters, personal computers or other word- processing equipment to transcribe correspondence and other documents, check and format documents prepared by other staff, deal with incoming and outgoing mail, screen requests for meetings or appointments, and perform a variety of administrative support tasks.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to the requirement for basic digital literacy and administrative skills.
outlook_rationale: Traditional secretarial and routine clerical roles face significant downward pressure in India as office automation tools and AI empower executives to manage their own correspondence and scheduling.
exposure_rationale: General secretarial tasks such as transcription, document formatting, email management, and scheduling are heavily subject to automation by AI assistants and generative tools.

title: Typists and Word Processing Operators
description: Typists and Word Processing Operators type, edit and print using typewriter, personal computer or other word processor, and record oral or written matter in shorthand.
pay_rationale: This is a low-skilled routine clerical role that typically commands earnings below the average for regular wage and salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Routine clerical and typing roles are declining as digital workflows, dictation software, and self-service office tools eliminate the need for dedicated typists.
exposure_rationale: Typing, word processing, and transcription tasks are directly and heavily automatable through advanced speech-to-text, automated document generation, and AI editing tools.

title: Data Entry Clerks
description: Data Entry Clerks enter coded, statistical, financial and other numerical data into electronic equipment, computerized databases, spreadsheets or other data repositories using a keyboard, mouse, or optical scanner, speech recognition software other data entry tools. They enter data into mechanical and electronic devices to perform mathematical calculations.
pay_rationale: Data entry is largely considered entry-level clerical work, typically commanding wages below the average for regular wage or salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Rapid advancements in automation and AI-driven data extraction are significantly reducing the demand for manual data entry roles.
exposure_rationale: Data entry is heavily digitized and routine, making it directly vulnerable to automation through OCR, document AI, and automated workflow tools.

title: Bank Tellers and Related Clerks
description: Bank Tellers and Related Clerks deal directly with clients of banks or post offices in connection with receiving, changing and paying out money, or providing mail services.
pay_rationale: Bank clerks typically earn slightly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to the formal banking sector context in India.
outlook_rationale: Routine banking tasks are increasingly digitized and automated, leading to a contraction in traditional teller and clerical headcounts despite growing banking penetration.
exposure_rationale: Digital banking, ATMs, and automated transaction systems heavily automate traditional teller duties, though some customer-facing verification remains.

title: Bookmakers, Croupiers and Related Gaming Workers
description: Bookmakers and croupiers and related gambling workers determine odds and receive and pay off bets on results of sporting or other events, or conduct games of chance in gambling establishments.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above average for clerical support roles due to the specialized nature of handling cash and managing gaming tables.
outlook_rationale: Growth in the formal entertainment and hospitality sector, alongside the expansion of legal gaming/betting formats in certain jurisdictions, drives moderate job creation.
exposure_rationale: While online gaming and digital platforms heavily automate betting and odds calculation, traditional physical casinos and betting houses still require human croupiers and bookmakers for live operations.

title: Pawnbrokers and Money-lenders
description: Pawnbrokers and money-lenders lend money against articles deposited as pledges, or against property or other security.
pay_rationale: Earnings vary widely based on capital availability, but established pawnbrokers typically earn slightly above the average for clerical and service support roles.
outlook_rationale: Traditional moneylending faces competition from fintech platforms, but micro-credit and gold loans continue to see stable demand across semi-urban and rural India.
exposure_rationale: Digital lending platforms and AI-driven credit assessment tools are increasingly used, but the core work of physical appraisal and local lending retains significant personal and manual elements.

title: Debt Collectors and Related Workers
description: Debt Collectors and Related Workers collect payments on overdue accounts and bad cheques and collect charity payments.
pay_rationale: Typical debt collectors are entry-level clerical workers earning close to the average monthly wage for regular salaried employees in India.
outlook_rationale: While digital automation is rising, the expansion of credit, fintech lending, and banking in India keeps demand for collection agents steady.
exposure_rationale: AI-powered automated calling systems, chatbots, and digital payment reminders can handle a large share of routine debt collection and follow-up tasks.

title: Travel Consultants and Clerks
description: Travel Consultants and Clerks supply information, arrange travel itineraries, obtain travel and accommodation reservations and organize group tours.
pay_rationale: Regular salaried travel clerks earn close to the average for clerical workers, depending slightly on commissions.
outlook_rationale: While the Indian tourism sector is booming, self-service online booking engines and AI-driven platforms are compressing traditional travel agency employment.
exposure_rationale: Much of travel planning, booking, and itinerary generation is being heavily disrupted by consumer-facing AI and automated booking platforms, reducing the need for routine clerical travel agents.

title: Telephone Switch Board Operators
description: Telephone Switch Board Operators operate telephone communications switchboards and consoles to establish telephone connections, receive caller inquiries and service problem reports, and record and relay messages to staff or clients.
pay_rationale: This is a declining clerical role typically associated with lower-end wages within the regular wage and salaried category.
outlook_rationale: The widespread adoption of automated routing and digital communication tools has sharply reduced the demand for traditional switchboard operators in India.
exposure_rationale: Automated switchboards, interactive voice response (IVR) systems, and AI-driven virtual assistants can handle incoming calls and route inquiries with virtually no human intervention.

title: Hotel Receptionists
description: Hotel receptionists register guests, assign rooms, issue keys, provide information concerning the hotel services, make room reservations, keep a record of rooms available for occupancy and present statements of charges to departing guests and receive payment.
pay_rationale: Entry-level hospitality service roles in India generally pay slightly below the average for regular wage-salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Expansion of India's tourism and hospitality sector will drive demand, though technology will moderate headcount growth per hotel.
exposure_rationale: Digital booking systems, automated check-ins, and AI-powered chatbots for reservations and customer inquiries handle an increasing share of front-desk tasks.

title: Inquiry Clerks
description: Inquiry Clerks respond to personal, written, electronic mail, and telephone enquiries and complaints about the organization’s goods, services and policies, provide information and refer people to other sources. They are employed in locations which put them in direct contact with clients or with the production of the goods and services provided.
pay_rationale: Pay is typical of entry-level regular wage clerical support workers in urban service sectors.
outlook_rationale: Routine clerical roles face downward employment pressure as organizations increasingly adopt automated customer service and AI-driven support solutions.
exposure_rationale: Inquiry clerks handle routine communications, emails, and phone inquiries, which are heavily automatable using conversational AI, chatbots, and automated ticketing systems.

title: Receptionist (General)
description: Receptionists (General) receive and welcome visitors, clients, or guests and respond to enquiries and requests including arranging for appointments.
pay_rationale: Entry-level administrative positions typically earn slightly below the average for regular wage or salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth in the corporate, hospitality, and healthcare sectors will drive demand, though automation will moderate overall expansion.
exposure_rationale: AI-powered chatbots, automated check-in kiosks, and intelligent scheduling systems can handle many routine enquiries and visitor management tasks.

title: Accounting and Bookkeeping Clerks
description: Accounting and Bookkeeping Clerks compute, classify, and record numerical data to keep financial records complete. They perform any combination of routine calculating, posting, and verifying duties to obtain primary financial data for use in maintaining accounting records.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried clerical workers due to the specialized numerical and financial knowledge required.
outlook_rationale: Adoption of advanced automated accounting platforms and AI tools in India is reducing the demand for traditional clerical bookkeeping roles.
exposure_rationale: Routine numerical data entry, calculation, and bookkeeping are heavily susceptible to automation and AI-driven accounting software.

title: Statistical Finance and Insurance Clerks
description: Statistical, Finance and Insurance Clerks obtain, compile and compute statistical or actuarial data or perform clerical tasks relating to the transactions of insurance establishments, banks and other financial establishments.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried employees due to the specific numerical and financial skills required.
outlook_rationale: Routine clerical and data entry roles in financial institutions are increasingly being automated through software and advanced banking systems, leading to a declining need for headcount in these specific job families.
exposure_rationale: The tasks of obtaining, compiling, and computing statistical or financial data are heavily rule-based and digitized, making them prime candidates for automation and AI-driven data processing tools.

title: Payroll Clerks
description: Payroll Clerks collect, verify and process payroll information and compute pay and benefit entitlements for employees within a department, company or other establishment.
pay_rationale: Regular wage employees in administrative roles typically earn slightly above the national average for salaried workers due to required literacy and basic accounting skills.
outlook_rationale: Routine clerical and paperwork roles face severe downward pressure in India as automated HR and payroll management software adoption spreads rapidly.
exposure_rationale: Payroll processing is fundamentally digital and relies heavily on structured data, calculations, and software automation, making it prime for near-total AI and software disruption.

title: Stock Clerks
description: Stock Clerks maintain records of goods produced and production materials received, weighed, issued, dispatched or put into stock.
pay_rationale: Routine clerical tasks in logistics and warehousing generally command wages slightly below the average for regular wage-salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: Growth in organized retail and e-commerce warehousing creates demand, but rising automation in inventory tracking limits the total number of new roles.
exposure_rationale: Stock tracking and record-keeping are increasingly automated through digital inventory management systems and barcode/RFID technology, reducing manual clerical work.

title: Transport Clerks
description: Transport Clerks keep records of operational aspects and co-ordinate the timing of train, road and air passenger and freight transport, and prepare reports for management.
pay_rationale: Pay is typical for a mid-level administrative clerk within the regular wage or salaried transportation sector.
outlook_rationale: While India's transport and logistics sector is expanding rapidly, routine clerical roles face displacement due to digital automation and enterprise software adoption.
exposure_rationale: Transport clerical tasks involve digital record-keeping, scheduling, and report preparation, which are increasingly automated by logistics software and AI.

title: Library Clerks
description: Library Clerks issue and receive library materials, sort and shelve books, sound and vision recordings, periodicals, journals, magazines and newspapers and provide general library information to library users.
pay_rationale: As a routine support role in the education and public sector, pay typically trends slightly below the average for regular wage and salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Digital transformation in libraries and the shift toward online resources are leading to a gradual decline in traditional physical library clerical roles.
exposure_rationale: Library cataloging, information retrieval, and patron inquiries are increasingly handled by automated digital systems and AI assistants, reducing the need for routine clerical tasks.

title: Mail Carriers and Sorting Clerks
description: Mail Carriers and Sorting Clerks perform sorting, recording, delivery and other duties in connection with mail services from post offices or related organizations, as well as from or within an establishment.
pay_rationale: Typically lower-skilled clerical and delivery roles within postal services earn slightly below the average for regular wage-salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Traditional postal mail volumes continue to decline with digital communication, while private couriers and logistics absorb parcel delivery demand.
exposure_rationale: Digital sorting technologies, automated logistics, and email adoption heavily reduce traditional mail sorting and clerical duties, though physical delivery retains some manual presence.

title: Coding, Proof-Reading and Related Clerks
description: Coding, Proof-Reading, and Related Clerks convert information into codes, verify and correct proofs, and perform a number of miscellaneous clerical duties.
pay_rationale: These routine clerical positions typically command wages slightly below the general average for regular salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Routine clerical and proof-reading roles face downward pressure and declining demand due to rapid adoption of automated digital tools and AI systems.
exposure_rationale: Coding, proof-reading, and routine clerical data verification tasks are heavily susceptible to automation via AI and optical character recognition technologies.

title: Scribes and Related Clerks
description: Scribes and Related Workers write letters and complete forms on behalf of illiterate persons.
pay_rationale: Scribes typically earn low, informal incomes well below the average for regular wage or self-employed workers.
outlook_rationale: As digital literacy and mobile internet penetration expand across India, the demand for traditional human scribes helping with letters and forms is steadily declining.
exposure_rationale: AI and smartphone proliferation (voice-to-text, automated form-filling, digital government services) directly automate the core tasks of scribes who help illiterate individuals with paperwork.

title: Clerical Support Workers, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This family Covers Clerical Support Workers not classified elsewhere in division 4, Clerical support workers. For instance, the group includes, Correspondence Clerks, Press Clippers and Publication Clerks.
pay_rationale: Pay aligns closely with average earnings for regular wage clerical staff in India.
outlook_rationale: Routine administrative and clerical roles face strong headwinds as organizations digitise and automate document processing.
exposure_rationale: Clerical support tasks like correspondence handling, clipping, and document management are heavily digital and routine, making them prime targets for automation.

title: Travel Attendants and Travel Stewards
description: Travel Attendants and Travel Stewards ensure the comfort and safety of passengers, serve meals and beverages and render personal services, usually on aircraft and on-board ships. They may plan and co-ordinate housekeeping and social activities on ships.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried service sector employees due to specialized training requirements.
outlook_rationale: Growth in tourism, aviation, and hospitality sectors in India will drive demand for travel attendants and stewards.
exposure_rationale: The role relies heavily on interpersonal communication, physical service, and safety management, which cannot be automated by AI.

title: Transport Conductors
description: Transport Conductors check and issue tickets and ensure the safety and comfort of passengers on trains, trams, buses and other public transport vehicles.
pay_rationale: Public transport conductors typically earn slightly below the average for regular wage or salaried workers in India, often working in state transport corporations.
outlook_rationale: While public transport demand is growing, the gradual shift towards automated ticketing, smart cards, and single-driver bus operations is slightly reducing the need for traditional conductors.
exposure_rationale: The role relies heavily on interpersonal communication, passenger management, and physical presence, meaning AI will only touch ticketing systems and digital scheduling.

title: Travel Guides
description: Travel Guides accompany individuals or groups on trips, sightseeing tours and excursions and on tours of places of interest such as historical sites, industrial establishments and theme parks. They describe points of interest and provide background information on interesting features.
pay_rationale: Earnings can be volatile and heavily dependent on tourist seasons, tips, and direct commissions, often aligning near average informal or salaried service wages.
outlook_rationale: Domestic and international tourism in India is expanding rapidly due to rising disposable incomes, government promotion, and infrastructure development, boosting demand for travel guides.
exposure_rationale: AI and digital mapping tools can replace informational aspects of the job, but the core role requires real-time interpersonal interaction, physical guidance, and local cultural context.

title: Cooks
description: Cooks plan, organize, prepare and cook meals in hotels, restaurants and other eating places, on board ships, on passenger trains and in private households.
pay_rationale: Cooks in India generally earn modest wages close to the average for regular wage or self-employed workers, depending on the establishment.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of the hospitality, tourism, and food delivery sectors in urban India will drive steady demand for cooks.
exposure_rationale: Cooking is a hands-on, physical craft requiring real-time sensory perception and manual dexterity, which AI cannot automate directly.

title: Waiters
description: Waiters serve food and beverages at tables in dining and drinking places, clubs, institutions and canteens, on board ships and on passenger trains.
