pay_rationale: Waiters in India typically earn wages below the average regular wage or self-employed worker baseline, often supplemented by modest tips.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of the hospitality, restaurant, tourism, and food delivery sectors in urban India will drive steady job creation for servers.
exposure_rationale: Waiters perform face-to-face interpersonal service and physical tasks, making them largely immune to direct AI automation, though digital ordering systems may change workflows.

title: Bartenders
description: Bartenders prepare, mix and serve alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks directly to customers over a bar or counter, or through waiters.
pay_rationale: Bartenders typically earn slightly above the average regular wage for service workers, augmented by tips and specialized mixology skills.
outlook_rationale: The expansion of India's hospitality, urban nightlife, and tourism sectors is driving steady demand for skilled bartenders in restaurants, bars, and hotels.
exposure_rationale: Bartending is fundamentally a hands-on service and hospitality role requiring physical presence and real-time human interaction, making it largely immune to direct AI automation.

title: Hairdressers
description: Hairdressers cut, style, colour, straighten and permanently wave hair, shave or trim facial hair and treat scalp conditions.
pay_rationale: While high-end salon stylists earn well, the vast majority of hairdressers in independent local shops earn modest incomes below the general self-employed average.
outlook_rationale: Urbanization and rising disposable incomes have increased demand for personal care services, driving steady employment growth across India.
exposure_rationale: Hairdressing is a hands-on, physical service occupation requiring manual dexterity and personal interaction, which AI cannot automate.

title: Beauticians and Related Workers
description: Beauticians and Related Workers, give facial and body beauty treatments, apply cosmetics and make-up and give other kinds of treatment to individuals in order to improve their appearance.
pay_rationale: Entry-level and general beauticians typically earn slightly below the average for self-employed or salaried service workers in urban areas.
outlook_rationale: Rising disposable incomes, urbanization, and a booming lifestyle and wellness sector in India are driving strong demand for beauty and personal care services.
exposure_rationale: The occupation is entirely hands-on and relies on interpersonal physical service, making it immune to direct automation by AI.

title: Cleaning and Housekeeping Supervisors in Offices, Hotels and Other Establishments
description: Cleaning and Housekeeping Supervisors in Offices, Hotels and Other Establishments organize, supervise and carry out housekeeping functions in order to keep clean and tidy the interiors, fixtures and facilities in these establishments.
pay_rationale: Earnings are generally slightly below or near the average for regular wage/salaried service sector employees in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth will be driven by the expanding hospitality sector, corporate offices, and commercial real estate developments across urban India.
exposure_rationale: The role requires physical presence, on-site supervision, and direct human management of cleaning staff, making it minimally exposed to AI automation.

title: Domestic Housekeepers
description: Domestic Housekeepers organize, supervise and carry out housekeeping functions in private households with or without the support of subordinate staff.
pay_rationale: Domestic housekeepers typically earn slightly below the average for regular wage or informal service workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Demand for domestic help is increasing in urban areas due to rising middle-class incomes and dual-income households.
exposure_rationale: Domestic housekeeping involves physical, in-person tasks and personal care that cannot be performed or replaced by digital AI systems.

title: Building Caretakers
description: Building Caretakers take care of apartment houses, hotels, offices, churches and other buildings and maintain them and associated grounds in a clean and orderly condition. They may supervise other workers and contractors depending on the size and nature of the building concerned.
pay_rationale: Building caretakers typically earn slightly below the average for regular wage or salaried service workers due to lower formal entry skill requirements.
outlook_rationale: Rapid urbanization and the proliferation of residential apartment complexes, commercial offices, and malls across Indian cities drive steady demand for building caretakers.
exposure_rationale: The role is fundamentally hands-on, involving physical cleaning, maintenance, and supervision of buildings, which cannot be automated by AI.

title: Astrologers, Fortune Tellers and Related
description: Workers Astrologers, Fortune-Tellers and Related Workers recount past and predict future events in persons’ lives by practicing astrology, on the basis of characteristics of the clients’ palms, samples of playing cards drawn or other techniques.
pay_rationale: Earnings vary widely from modest fees for local practitioners to substantial incomes for renowned consultants, averaging around the category norm.
outlook_rationale: Demand for astrological and spiritual consultation remains steady due to cultural traditions, though growth will be moderate as younger demographics shift toward digital platforms.
exposure_rationale: While AI can generate horoscope readings, the occupation relies heavily on interpersonal trust, personal consultation, and cultural traditions, limiting direct automation.

title: Undertakers and Embalmers
description: Undertakers and Embalmers perform various tasks in the disposal of dead human bodies.
pay_rationale: Typically organized as small informal service providers or low-wage support staff, earning slightly below the average for service workers.
outlook_rationale: Demand grows steadily with population growth and urbanization, though the occupation remains a niche traditional service sector.
exposure_rationale: The role requires direct physical handling and preparation of human remains, which is entirely manual and interpersonal.

title: Stall and Market Salespersons
description: Stall and market salespersons sell various goods from stalls on open-air or covered markets or from stalls in streets or other open spaces.
pay_rationale: Earnings for typical stall and market vendors tend to be lower than the average self-employed baseline due to low capital and margins.
outlook_rationale: Informal retail and street vending continue to grow alongside urban population growth, though modern retail poses some competition.
exposure_rationale: The role relies entirely on in-person selling and physical interaction at markets, leaving little room for AI disruption.

title: Street Food Salespersons
description: Street Food Salespersons prepare and sell, or sell previously prepared, hot or cold foods and beverages ready for immediate consumption in streets and public places such as stations, cinemas, or theatres.
pay_rationale: Earnings are generally low and dependent on daily foot traffic, placing them slightly below the average for self-employed workers.
outlook_rationale: Urbanization and the growing demand for affordable ready-to-eat food continue to expand the street food sector, though it remains largely informal.
exposure_rationale: The role relies entirely on physical food preparation, vending, and direct cash or digital transactions in public spaces, which AI cannot automate.

title: Shop Supervisors
description: Shop Supervisors supervise and co- ordinate the activities of shop Sales Assistants, Checkout Operators and other Workers in retail and wholesale shops such as supermarkets and department stores.
pay_rationale: Shop supervisors earn slightly above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to supervisory responsibilities.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of organized retail, supermarkets, and shopping malls across urban and semi-urban India drives strong demand for retail supervisors.
exposure_rationale: AI and automation can assist with inventory management, scheduling, and sales analytics, but the core job requires on-site supervision, human interaction, and floor management.

title: Shop Sales Assistants
description: Shop Sales Assistants sell a range of goods and services directly to the public or on behalf of retail and wholesale establishments, and explain the functions and qualities of these goods and services.
pay_rationale: Shop sales assistants typically earn below the national average for regular wage or self-employed workers due to low entry-level skill requirements.
outlook_rationale: Retail expansion across urban and semi-urban India continues to drive steady demand for sales assistants, despite growth in online retail.
exposure_rationale: While e-commerce and automated checkouts are changing retail, shop sales assistants rely heavily on in-person customer service, persuasion, and physical stocking, limiting direct AI automation.

title: Fashion and Other Models
description: Fashion and Other Models wear and display clothing and accessories and pose for photographs, film and video, advertising, still photography or for artistic creations.
pay_rationale: Successful models can earn significantly above the average service worker salary, though earnings vary widely based on individual prominence and commercial contracts.
outlook_rationale: Driven by the expansion of the Indian retail sector, e-commerce platforms, digital marketing, and the fashion industry, demand for visual advertising talent is expected to grow steadily.
exposure_rationale: While digital avatars and AI-generated imagery pose a growing challenge for traditional modeling in advertising and e-commerce, live fashion shows, fit modeling, and high-end artistic creation still require human presence.

title: Sales Demonstrators
description: Sales Demonstrators demonstrate goods at commercial premises, exhibitions and private homes.
pay_rationale: Typically entry-level sales or promotional roles with earnings often below the overall average for regular wage or self-employed workers.
outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by the expanding retail sector, shopping malls, and product promotion events in urban areas.
exposure_rationale: AI can assist with marketing materials and customer profiling, but the core function requires physical presence, live demonstration, and interpersonal persuasion.

title: Door-to-Door Salespersons Door to Door Salespersons sell goods and services and solicit business for an establishment, by approaching or visiting potential customers, usually residents in private homes, by going from door to door.
pay_rationale: Door-to-door sales typically rely on commissions and lower base pay, placing earnings slightly below the average for self-employed or salaried sales workers.
outlook_rationale: While e-commerce continues to expand, direct selling of specialized consumer goods, financial products, and services remains an active channel in many Indian markets.

exposure_rationale: The work involves hands-on mechanical crafting, calibration, and physical repair of precision instruments, which are physical tasks that resist direct automation.

title: Musical Instrument Makers and
description: Tuners Musical-instrument makers and tuners make, assemble, repair, adjust, restore musical instruments and tune them to the required pitch with hand or power tools. They usually specialize in one type of instrument, such as string instruments, brass instruments, reed instruments or percussion instruments.
pay_rationale: Earnings for traditional craftspeople and artisans are typically close to the average for self-employed or skilled craft workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Traditional craftsmanship faces steady niche demand from musicians and cultural institutions, but overall employment growth remains slow as mass-produced instruments dominate.
exposure_rationale: This occupation relies heavily on manual craftsmanship, tactile skills, and physical tuning of acoustic instruments, which cannot be automated by artificial intelligence.

title: Jewellery and Precision Metal Workers
description: Jewellery and precious metal workers design, fabricate, adjust, repair, or appraise jewellery, ceremonial or religious items, gold, silver, other precious metals, or gems. They cut, file, polish and set precious and semi-precious stones including gems and diamonds and engrave designs on jewellery and precious metal articles. They cut and polish diamonds for industrial purposes.
pay_rationale: Skilled artisans and jewellers often earn slightly above the average regular wage/salaried worker due to the specialized craftsmanship required.
outlook_rationale: Steady demand for traditional and modern jewellery in India supports slow growth, though constrained by a gradual shift toward organized retail and mechanized manufacturing.
exposure_rationale: The work requires fine manual dexterity, physical craftsmanship, and artisanal skills in handling precious metals and stones, which AI cannot automate directly.

title: Potters and Related Workers
description: Potters and related workers prepare pottery, porcelain ware, sanitary ware, bricks, tiles and abrasive wheels by hand or by machine.
pay_rationale: Most traditional potters in India operate in the informal sector and earn relatively low incomes compared to the broader self-employed average.
outlook_rationale: Traditional craft potters face competitive pressure from mass-produced industrial and plastic alternatives, leading to slow or slightly declining employment.
exposure_rationale: Pottery making is a traditional, hands-on craft reliant on manual dexterity and physical manipulation of clay, which AI cannot automate directly.

title: Glass Makers, Cutters, Grinders and Finishers
description: Glass makers, cutters, grinders and finishers blow, mould, press, cut, trim, grind and polish glass, shape molten glass according to patterns.
pay_rationale: Earnings for craft and related trades workers typically hover near the average for regular wage or self-employed workers depending on the scale of operation.
outlook_rationale: Steady demand for traditional and decorative glassware supports the craft, though growth is constrained by industrial automation in larger glass manufacturing units.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves manual craftsmanship, physical handling, and shaping of molten glass, which are difficult to automate directly with current AI and robotics in traditional Indian workshops.

title: Sign Writer, Decorative Painters, Engravers and
description: Etchers Sign Writers, Decorative Painters, Engravers and Etchers decorate articles made of wood, metal, textiles, glass, ceramics and other materials. They plan, lay out and paint letters, figures, monograms and designs to make signs and engrave and etch ornament and floral designs on glass and other articles.
pay_rationale: Most sign writers and decorative painters operate as self-employed artisans or small workshop workers earning slightly below the broad self-employed average.
outlook_rationale: Demand for traditional hand-painted signs and custom engraving faces strong competition from digital printing and mass manufacturing, leading to modest, stable growth primarily in niche artisanal segments.
exposure_rationale: While digital design tools and automated laser/CNC engraving machines handle much of the layout and bulk production, skilled traditional sign writing and decorative painting still require manual craftsmanship and physical artistry.

title: Handicraft Workers in Wood, Basketry and Related
description: Materials Handicraft workers in wood and related materials apply traditional techniques like seasoning, impregnation to prepare wood, straw, rattan, reeds, stone, clay, shells, and other materials, and carve, mould, assemble, weave, or paint and decorate various articles for personal or household use, or for decorative purposes. Basketry Divison 7 weavers, brush makers and related workers select and prepare materials like bristles, nylon, fibre, bass, whisker and wire to make wicker furniture, brushes and brooms and weave various kinds of baskets.
pay_rationale: Handicraft workers generally earn below the average for self-employed or casual craft workers due to low margins and competition.
outlook_rationale: Traditional craft and basketry face pressure from mass-produced plastic and machine-made goods, leading to a slow decline in traditional livelihoods despite niche high-end markets.
exposure_rationale: This occupation relies heavily on physical craftsmanship, manual dexterity, and traditional techniques working with wood, basketry, and natural materials, leaving virtually no room for digital automation.

title: Handicraft Workers in Textiles, Leather and Related Materials Divison
description: 7 Handicraft workers in textile, leather and related materials apply traditional techniques and patterns to produce woven fabrics, knitted, embroidered, woven and other garments and articles for household use, as well as traditional footwear, handbags, belts and other accessories.
pay_rationale: Traditional artisans and handicraft workers in India often earn below the national average for self-employed workers due to market intermediaries and low bargaining power.
outlook_rationale: Traditional handicrafts face steady demand due to cultural heritage and e-commerce expansion, though growth is tempered by competition from mass-produced goods.
exposure_rationale: Handicraft production relies heavily on manual dexterity, traditional skills, and physical craftsmanship, which are largely shielded from direct AI automation.

title: Pre-press Technicians
description: Pre-press Technicians proof, format, set and compose text and graphics into a form suitable for use in various printing processes and representation in other visual media.
pay_rationale: Skilled technical proficiency in graphic tools commands slightly above average pay for regular wage workers in printing establishments.
outlook_rationale: Traditional print media is facing stagnation while digital media expands, leading to flat or slightly declining demand for print-focused pre-press roles.
exposure_rationale: Digital formatting, typesetting, and graphic preparation are increasingly automated by AI-driven layout tools and design software.

title: Printers
description: Printers set up and operate digital, letterpress, lithographic, flexographic, gravure, newspaper and other printing presses.
pay_rationale: Earnings align closely with standard wages for skilled craft and related trades workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Traditional printing and publishing face digital substitution, though packaging and specialized print sectors maintain steady demand.
exposure_rationale: Printers operate physical machinery and digital prepress equipment, combining manual skills and machine tending with increasing digital workflow automation.

title: Print Finishing and Binding Workers Divison
description: 7 Print finishing and binding workers bind books and other publications, and finish printed products by hand or machine.
pay_rationale: Print finishing and binding workers typically earn modest wages near or slightly below the average for regular wage or casual workers in manufacturing.
outlook_rationale: Traditional print media faces stagnant to declining demand as digital publishing grows, though packaging and specialized binding retain some localized demand.
exposure_rationale: Print finishing and binding rely heavily on mechanical and manual operations for handling physical materials, though digital workflow management and automated machinery controls are increasingly used.

title: Building and Related Electricians
description: Building and related electricians install, maintain and repair electrical wiring systems and related equipment and fixtures.
pay_rationale: Skilled building electricians often earn slightly above average wages for craft workers due to the technical expertise and safety risks involved.
outlook_rationale: Strong real estate development, urban infrastructure projects, and increasing electrification across India drive robust demand for skilled electricians.
exposure_rationale: Electricians perform physical installation and repair of wiring and fixtures, which cannot be automated by AI, though AI may assist with diagnostic tools.

title: Electrical Mechanics and Fitters Divison
description: 7 Electrical mechanics and fitters fit, adjust, install and repair electrical machinery and other electrical apparatus and equipment in buildings, factories, workshops, or other places.
pay_rationale: Earns slightly above the average for regular wage or self-employed craft workers due to the technical electrical skills required.
outlook_rationale: Urbanization, industrial expansion, and widespread electrification across India ensure a strong, steady demand for skilled electrical mechanics and fitters.
exposure_rationale: Electrical mechanics and fitters perform hands-on physical installation, adjustment, and repair of electrical machinery, meaning AI can only assist with diagnostic documentation rather than physical execution.

title: Electrical Line Installers and Repairers
description: Electrical Line Installers and Repairers install, repair and join electrical transmission and supply cables and related equipment.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage/salaried trades due to the specialized technical skills and physical risks involved.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of power grids, rural electrification initiatives, and infrastructure development across India will drive steady demand for line installers.
exposure_rationale: The work is heavily physical, requiring manual dexterity, climbing, and outdoor fieldwork, meaning AI can only assist with digital documentation and grid monitoring.

title: Electrical and Electronic Equipment Mechanics and Fitters and Related Workers, Not Elsewhere Classified
description: This Family covers workers not elsewhere classified in the Group 724, Electrical and electronic equipment mechanics and fitters. For instance, occupations involving inspection of television receivers during final assembly, checking of telephone and telegraph equipment, doing armature and coil winding, repairing and charging battery, replacing blown out fuses etc.
pay_rationale: Typically organized as regular wage or self-employed craft workers earning slightly below broader formal salaried averages.
outlook_rationale: Demand grows steadily with expanding electrification, consumer electronics, and automotive sectors in India, though much of the work remains informal.
exposure_rationale: The work involves physical mechanics, equipment inspection, battery repair, and manual winding, leaving little room for direct AI automation.

title: Electronic Mechanics and Servicers
description: Electronics mechanics and servicers fit, maintain, adjust and repair electronic equipment such as commercial and office machines and electronic instruments and control systems.
pay_rationale: Typically earns around the average for skilled regular wage or self-employed technical workers in the service sector.
outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by the rapid proliferation of electronic devices, home appliances, and industrial automation across India.
exposure_rationale: While diagnostics and manuals are increasingly digital, the core of the work requires physical handling, soldering, and mechanical repair of hardware components.

title: Information and Communications Technology Installers and Servicers
description: Information and communications technology (ICT) installers and servicers install, repair and maintain Divison 7 telecommunications equipment, data transmission equipment, cables, antennae and conduits and repair, fit and maintain computers.
pay_rationale: Specialized technical skills in ICT installation command a slight premium over average regular wage earnings.
outlook_rationale: Rapid expansion of telecom networks, 5G deployment, and rising computer penetration across India drive strong demand for ICT installers.
exposure_rationale: While installation and physical repairs require hands-on labor, diagnostic tools and technical manuals are increasingly digitized and augmented by AI.

title: Butchers, Fishmongers and Related Food Preparers
description: Butchers, fishmongers and related food preparers slaughter animals, clean, cut and dress meat and fish, remove bones and prepare related food items or preserve meat, fish and other foods and food products by drying, salting or smoking.
pay_rationale: Typically performed as a trade with modest earnings relative to the average self-employed or casual labour benchmark in India.
outlook_rationale: Demand for processed meat, fish, and organized retail food supply chains is steadily growing in urban India, supporting moderate employment growth.
exposure_rationale: This occupation involves physical hand-eye coordination, manual skill, and physical presence to slaughter, cut, and prepare meat and fish, which cannot be automated by AI.

title: Bakers, Pastry-Cooks and Confectionery Makers
description: Bakers, pastry-cooks and confectionery makers make various kinds of bread, cakes, and other flour products, as well as handmade chocolate and sugar confectionery.
pay_rationale: Wages for typical craft bakers in India are close to the average for regular wage or self-employed workers in the food sector.
outlook_rationale: Growth is driven by rising urbanization, expanding café culture, and increased demand for processed and bakery foods in India.
exposure_rationale: The work is primarily physical and hand-crafted, requiring manual skills and sensory judgment that AI cannot replicate.

title: Dairy Products Makers
description: Dairy products makers process butter and various types of cheese, cream or other dairy products.
pay_rationale: Earnings typically align slightly below or near the average for skilled craft workers in the manufacturing and food processing sector.
outlook_rationale: Driven by rising demand for processed dairy goods in urban Indian markets, though traditional methods and small-scale setups remain prominent.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves hands-on processing and physical craft skills in dairy production, which have low susceptibility to AI automation.

title: Fruits, Vegetables and Related Preservers
description: Fruit, vegetable and related preservers process or preserve fruit, nuts and related foods in various ways including cooking, drying, salting, or juice or oil extraction.
pay_rationale: This craft trade typically offers wages slightly below the average for regular wage or casual workers in the manufacturing sector.
outlook_rationale: Growth in the packaged food processing industry in India will create steady demand for food preservation and processing workers.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves manual and machinery-based physical processing of food items, which has low direct automation risk although monitoring systems are increasingly digital.

title: Food and Beverage Tasters and Graders
description: Food and beverage tasters and graders inspect, taste and grade various types of agricultural products, food and beverages.
pay_rationale: Specialized sensory evaluation requires specific expertise, commanding a modest premium over average regular wage workers.
outlook_rationale: Growth will be driven by the expansion of India's processed food, beverage, and export industries, requiring quality control standards.
exposure_rationale: While AI can assist with spectral and chemical analysis of food, the core of this occupation relies on human sensory perception (taste, smell, and texture) which cannot be automated.

title: Tobacco Preparers and Tobacco Products Makers II
description: B 253 Tobacco preparers and tobacco products makers prepare tobacco leaves and make various tobacco products.
pay_rationale: Workers in traditional cottage-industry tobacco preparation (such as bidi rolling) typically earn low wages near the lower end of the casual labour scale.
outlook_rationale: Declining demand for traditional tobacco products due to increasing health awareness and regulatory pressures will likely constrain employment growth.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves manual handling and processing of physical materials like tobacco leaves, leaving virtually no room for AI automation.

title: Wood Treaters
description: Wood treaters operate and tend wood treatment processing equipment and machines to remove bark from logs, produce wood chips, season, preserve and treat wood, and produce wafer boards, particleboards, hardboards, insulation boards, plywood, veneers and similar wood products.
pay_rationale: This occupation involves semi-skilled manual labor in manufacturing, yielding earnings somewhat below the average for regular wage-salaried workers in India.
outlook_rationale: Employment in wood processing and manufacturing moves broadly with construction and furniture sectors, experiencing slow, steady growth driven by industrial demand.
exposure_rationale: Wood treaters perform physical, machinery-tending tasks in wood processing and manufacturing that require manual operation and physical presence, leaving minimal room for direct AI automation.

title: Cabinet Makers and Related
description: Workers Cabinet-makers and related workers make, decorate and repair wooden Divison 7 furniture, carts and other vehicles, wheels, parts, fittings, patterns, models and other wooden products using woodworking machines, machine tools and specialized hand tools.
pay_rationale: Skilled artisan cabinet makers earn roughly in line with average self-employed or skilled craft wages in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by steady demand in urban real estate and interior design, though constrained by increasing adoption of modular, factory-made furniture.
exposure_rationale: Cabinet making is a hands-on craft involving physical material processing and manual skills, meaning AI will only marginally impact the actual production process.

title: Wood Working Machine Tool Setters and
description: Operators Woodworking Machine Tool Setters and Operators set-up or operate and monitor automatic or semi-automatic woodworking machines, such as precision sawing, shaping, planning, boring, turning and woodcarving machines to fabricate or repair wooden parts for furniture, fixtures and other wooden products.
pay_rationale: Most craft and related trade workers in India earn slightly below the average for regular wage or casual workers depending on the informal nature of most small carpentry units.
outlook_rationale: Steady growth is expected driven by the expanding Indian real estate, construction, and organized furniture manufacturing sectors.
exposure_rationale: The occupation is primarily hands-on and physical, involving the operation and setup of heavy machinery to manipulate wood, limiting direct AI automation.

title: Tailors, Dress Makers, Furriers and
description: Hatters Tailors, dressmakers, furriers and hatters fabricate, fit, alter and repair tailored or hand-made clothing; They produce made- to-measure clothing such as suits, overcoats, and dresses from textile fabrics, light leather, fur and other material, or make hats or wigs according to customer’s and clothing manufacturer’s specifications.
pay_rationale: Most tailors and dressmakers in India operate as self-employed artisans or small-shop workers earning modest incomes below the national average for self-employed workers.
outlook_rationale: Steady demand for custom garments, ethnic wear, and alterations in the domestic market supports growth, though offset by mass-produced ready-made apparel.
exposure_rationale: Tailoring and dressmaking require physical dexterity, hand-eye coordination, and direct interpersonal interaction for measurements and fittings, making them virtually immune to direct AI automation.

title: Garment and Related Pattern Makers and Cutters
description: Textile, leather and related patternmakers and cutters create precision master patterns for production of garments, II B 275 other textile, and leather or fur products. They mark, cut, shape and trim textile, light leather and other materials according to blueprints or specifications in the manufacture of garments, hats and caps, gloves and miscellaneous products.
pay_rationale: Skilled garment cutters typically earn around the average for regular wage or craft workers in the manufacturing sector.
outlook_rationale: Employment in India's textile and apparel manufacturing sector is growing steadily with domestic and export demand, though heavily concentrated in informal and semi-formal clusters.
exposure_rationale: Pattern making and cutting require tactile skills, physical dexterity, and material handling that resist direct automation, though CAD software is increasingly used in larger garment factories.

title: Sewing, Embroiderers and Related Workers II B
description: 279 Sewing, embroidery and related workers sew together, repair, renovate and decorate garments, gloves and other products of textile, fur, light leather and other materials and fabricate tents sails, awnings and tarpaulins. They work mainly by hand using a needle and thread but may perform some tasks using a sewing machine.
pay_rationale: Hand embroiderers and traditional sewing workers often earn on the lower end of the self-employed or informal wage scale in India due to high labor supply.
outlook_rationale: Demand for traditional handloom, embroidery, and customized garments remains stable, though offset by mass manufacturing and automation in textile production.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves manual crafting, sewing, and embroidery which require physical dexterity and hands-on skill, meaning AI can only impact peripheral administrative tasks.

title: Upholsterers and Related Workers
description: Upholsterers and related workers install, repair and replace upholstery of furniture, fixtures, orthopaedic appliances; seats, panels, convertible and vinyl tops and other furnishings of automobiles, railway coaches, aircraft, ships and similar items with fabric, leather, rexine or other upholstery material. They also make and repair cushions, quilts and mattresses.
pay_rationale: Typically organized as self-employed artisans or informal workshop workers earning slightly below the national average for self-employed/casual craft workers.
outlook_rationale: Steady demand driven by urbanisation, real estate development, and growth in the automotive and hospitality sectors, though largely informal.
exposure_rationale: The work is almost entirely manual, requiring physical dexterity, hand tools, and direct manipulation of physical materials like fabric and foam, which AI cannot automate.

title: Pelt Dressers, Tanners and Fellmongers
description: Pelt dressers, tanners and fellmongers trim, scrape, clean, tan, buff and dye animal hides, pelts or skins to produce leather stock and finished furs for making garments and other products.
pay_rationale: Typically constitutes low-wage craft labor performed in unorganized or semi-organized tanneries earning below the average casual or manual wage category.
outlook_rationale: Traditional leather tanning and pelt processing faces steady domestic demand, but growth is constrained by environmental regulations and modernization toward larger mechanized units.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves manual physical labor and traditional craft skills related to treating animal hides, which cannot be automated by software AI.

title: Shoemakers and Related Workers
description: Shoemakers and related workers make, modify and repair standard, custom or orthopaedic footwear and natural or synthetic leather articles, such as luggage, handbags and belts, (except for leather garments, hats and gloves), or participate in the manufacture of shoes and related goods. They decorate, reinforce or finish shoes, luggage, handbags and belts.
pay_rationale: Most shoemakers and leather workers operate in the informal sector as self-employed artisans or small workshop workers earning below the broader self-employed average.
outlook_rationale: Traditional artisan shoemakers and repairers face ongoing pressure from mass-produced, inexpensive footwear and modern retail manufacturing, resulting in stagnant or slightly declining demand for traditional craft labor.
exposure_rationale: Shoemaking and leather repair are predominantly manual, craft-based trades requiring physical dexterity and material manipulation, leaving them largely insulated from direct AI automation.

title: Underwater Divers
description: Underwater divers work under the surface of water, using underwater breathing apparatus to inspect, install, repair, and remove equipment and structures, conduct tests or experiments, rig explosives, photograph structures or marine life or find and recover missing items and persons.
pay_rationale: Specialized high-risk technical skills command a wage premium significantly above the average regular salaried or contract worker.
outlook_rationale: Growth is driven by maritime infrastructure development, offshore energy exploration, and marine construction projects in India.
exposure_rationale: The physical and hazard-heavy nature of underwater work limits AI's direct impact, though AI may assist with sonar data analysis and remote-operated vehicle (ROV) support.

title: Shotfirers and Blasters
description: Shotfirers and blasters, position, assemble, and detonate explosives at mining, quarrying and demolition sites.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage or casual workers in mining due to the specialized and hazardous nature of handling explosives.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth driven by ongoing infrastructure development, road construction, and mining activities in India, though tempered by safety regulations.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves physical hazard management, handling explosives, and manual positioning at mining and demolition sites, which cannot be automated by software AI.

title: Product Graders and Testers (Excluding Food and Beverages)
description: Product graders and testers (except foods and beverages) inspect, test, sort, sample, and weigh raw materials, manufactured components and non-comestible goods produced or sold, to ensure compliance with quality standards and to identify defects, wear, and deviations from specifications, and to grade and classify them according to their quality.
pay_rationale: Pay is generally close to the average for regular wage-salaried workers in the manufacturing sector.
outlook_rationale: Growth will be supported by the expansion of manufacturing and quality compliance demands under 'Make in India' initiatives, though somewhat tempered by automation.
exposure_rationale: While automated optical inspection and machine vision systems are increasingly used in manufacturing, human graders and testers are still widely required for physical inspection, tactile judgment, and quality control tasks in India's industrial sector.

title: Miners and Quarriers
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Miners and Quarriers operate plant, machinery and hand tools to extract rock, minerals and non-metallic deposits from underground and surface mines and quarries.
pay_rationale: Miners earn slightly above average casual or regular wages due to the hazardous and physically demanding nature of the work.
outlook_rationale: Employment in traditional mining is expected to remain largely flat or slowly decline due to mechanization and environmental shifts, despite steady demand for minerals.
exposure_rationale: Mining involves heavy physical labor, machinery operation, and underground work which cannot be automated by digital AI, though surface-level monitoring may see minor software integration.

title: Mineral and Stone Processing Plant Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Mineral and Stone Processing Plant Operators operate and monitor machinery and equipment for processing rocks, minerals and stone to recover refined products for immediate use or further processing.
pay_rationale: Typically organized as regular wage or salaried workers in industrial plants, earning close to the sector average for skilled plant operators.
outlook_rationale: Steady demand for construction materials and minerals supports moderate job stability, though mechanization will limit rapid headcount expansion.
exposure_rationale: While plant automation and IoT sensors are increasing in mining and processing facilities, the physical operation, monitoring, and maintenance of heavy machinery still require human presence.

title: Well Drillers and Borers and Related Workers
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Well drillers and borers and related workers position, assemble and operate drilling machinery and related equipment to sink wells, extract ore, liquids and gases or for a variety of other purposes.
pay_rationale: Specialized machine operators in construction and mining typically earn slightly above the average for regular wage or self-employed workers due to technical skills.
outlook_rationale: Demand for drilling and boring will see steady, moderate growth driven by infrastructure projects, water borewells, and mining activities across India.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves manual machine operation and physical field work, meaning AI's impact is limited to auxiliary logistics, planning, or monitoring tools.

title: Cement, Stone and Other Mineral Products Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Cement, Stone and Other Mineral Products Machine Operators operate and II B 327 monitor machines for manufacturing and finishing precast concrete, bitumen, and stone products, and making cast stone for building purposes.
pay_rationale: Pay is comparable to average regular wage or manual manufacturing rates in the industrial sector.
outlook_rationale: Strong infrastructure development and construction activity in India drive steady demand for building and mineral products.
exposure_rationale: Machine operation is primarily physical and mechanical, with AI only marginally impacting process monitoring or documentation.

title: Metal Processing Plant Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Metal Processing Plant Operators, operate, monitor, adjust and maintain, single process machinery and equipment to process and convert mineral ores and refine, harden, roll and extrude metals. Divison 8
pay_rationale: Skilled plant operators earn moderately above the average for regular wage-salaried workers due to technical requirements.
outlook_rationale: Growth is tied to India's expanding infrastructure and manufacturing sector, boosting demand for steel and refined metals.
exposure_rationale: Metal processing involves heavy physical machinery operation and monitoring, limiting direct automation, though process control systems are becoming more digitized.

title: Metal Finishing, Plating and Coating Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Metal Finishing, Plating and Coating Machine Operators operate and monitor equipment which finishes, plates and coats metal articles or parts, in order to give them improved resistance to corrosion and abrasion, for decorative purposes, or to impart electrical or magnetic properties.
pay_rationale: Pay is typical of semi-skilled machine operators in the manufacturing sector.
outlook_rationale: Growth is tied to the manufacturing sector under 'Make in India' initiatives, though process automation may limit rapid head-count expansion.
exposure_rationale: The occupation involves operating physical machinery and handling metal parts, which is predominantly a manual and machine-tending role with minimal digital interaction.

title: Chemical Products Plant and Machine Operators Divison
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: 8 Chemical Products Plant and Machine Operators monitor and operate units and machinery to blend, mix, process and package a wide range of chemical products.
pay_rationale: Pay is slightly above the average for regular wage workers due to the specialized skills required for handling chemical plants.
outlook_rationale: Moderate growth driven by the expanding Indian chemical and manufacturing sector, though offset by increasing automation in modern plants.
exposure_rationale: Machine operation involves physical monitoring and manual controls, though process automation and IoT systems are increasingly introduced in chemical plants.

title: Photographic Products Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Photographic Products Machine Operators operate and monitor equipment which makes photographic film and paper, and which processes exposed photographic film and makes prints.
pay_rationale: As a declining niche trade, wages for photographic machine operators tend to be lower than the average for regular manufacturing machine operators.
outlook_rationale: Rapid digitization of photography and the decline of traditional film and chemical processing strongly constrain job growth in this area.
exposure_rationale: The shift toward digital photography has severely reduced the demand for traditional film processing, and machine operation tasks are increasingly automated or obsolete.

title: Rubber Products Machine Operators Divison
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: 8 Rubber Products Machine Operators operate and monitor machines which knead and blend rubber and rubber compounds, and produce various components and products from natural and synthetic rubber, such as moulded footwear, domestic articles, insulating materials, industrial accessories, or tyres.
pay_rationale: Earnings are close to the average for regular wage or salaried manufacturing machine operators in India.
outlook_rationale: Growth is tied to the expansion of the domestic manufacturing and automotive sectors, though offset by increasing factory automation.
exposure_rationale: While machine automation is increasing, the physical monitoring and operation of rubber processing equipment require manual intervention, limiting direct AI substitution.

title: Plastic Products Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Plastic Products Machine Operators operate and monitor machines which knead and blend compounds to obtain plastic materials and which make various plastic components and articles.
pay_rationale: Typically positioned as blue-collar factory workers, their earnings are slightly below the average for regular wage/salaried employees.
outlook_rationale: Growth in manufacturing and consumer goods packaging in India will steadily drive demand for skilled machine operators in the plastic industry.
exposure_rationale: Machine operations involve physical monitoring and adjustments, limiting direct automation by software, though industrial IoT and smart manufacturing will increasingly assist.

title: Paper Products Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Paper Products Machine Operators operate and monitor machines which produce boxes, envelopes, bags and other goods from paper, paperboard, cardboard and similar materials.
pay_rationale: Factory machine operators earn slightly below or around the average for regular wage workers depending on skill level.
outlook_rationale: Growth in e-commerce, packaging, and retail will drive steady demand for paper packaging products, though increasing factory mechanization will temper total headcount growth.
exposure_rationale: Machine operation requires physical presence and manual material handling, limiting direct AI automation, though indirect automation via smart factory systems may gradually impact the role.

title: Fibre Preparing, Spinning and Winding Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Fibre Preparing, Spinning and Winding Machine Operators operate and monitor machines which prepare fibres, and spin, double, twist and wind yarn and thread from natural textile fibres. They twist two or more strands of yarn to prepare single stronger, smoother, uniform and heavier strands and treat textiles to make them stiff and water resistant.
pay_rationale: As semi-skilled operatives in manufacturing, earnings typically fall below the national average for regular wage or salaried workers.
outlook_rationale: The Indian textile industry is expanding due to government support and exports, though increasing mechanization moderates direct job growth.
exposure_rationale: Machine operators require physical presence and manual intervention to tend textile machinery, limiting AI's direct impact mainly to automated monitoring systems.

title: Weaving and Knitting Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Weaving and Knitting Machine Operators set up, operate and monitor weaving and knitting machines which process yarn or thread into woven, non-woven and knitted products such as cloth, lace, carpets, rope, industrial fabric, hosiery and knitted garments or to quilt and embroider fabric.
pay_rationale: Machine operators in the textile sector typically earn modest wages slightly below the average for regular wage or casual industrial workers.
outlook_rationale: Employment in textile manufacturing remains steady with moderate growth driven by exports and domestic demand, though automation puts pressure on headcount growth.
exposure_rationale: While machine automation is high in textile manufacturing, operating the physical machinery requires hands-on monitoring, yarn management, and intervention, limiting pure AI substitution.

title: Sewing Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
description: Sewing Machine Operators operate and monitor sewing machines to make, repair, darn and renovate textile, fur, synthetic or leather garments or embroider ornamental designs on garments or other materials. They operate button hole making and eyelet holing machines to cut holes, stitch around holes, stitch buttons and fix eyelets to garments.
pay_rationale: Most sewing machine operators are employed in low-wage manufacturing units and sweatshops, earning below the national average for regular wage or casual workers.
outlook_rationale: Growth is supported by the expanding Indian textile and apparel manufacturing sector, though moderate due to rising automation and machinery efficiency.
exposure_rationale: The role requires manual dexterity and physical operation of sewing machinery, limiting direct AI automation of the core task, though automated cutting and sewing robotics may increasingly impact factory environments.

title: Bleaching, Dyeing and Cleaning Machine Operators
category: Plant and Machine Operators and Assemblers
